title_en: Continual Model Routing in Evolving Model Hubs
title_zh: 演化模型中心中的持续模型路由

sentences.en: AI model hubs provide access to a rapidly growing collection of powerful pre-trained models, enabling off-the-shelf mixture-of-experts systems with different routing strategies.
sentences.zh: AI 模型中心提供对快速增长的强大预训练模型集合的访问，使采用不同路由策略的开箱即用混合专家系统成为可能。

sentences.en: However, this rapid growth poses two fundamental challenges: scaling model selection across thousands of experts and continually updating routing mechanisms as new models and tasks are introduced.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种快速增长带来两个根本性挑战：跨数千个专家扩展模型选择，以及随新模型与新任务的引入持续更新路由机制。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formalise this setting as Continual Model Routing (CMR) and propose *CMRBench*, a new large-scale benchmark simulating realistic hub expansion and including over 2,000 candidate models.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将这一设定形式化为持续模型路由（CMR），并提出 *CMRBench*，一个模拟现实中心扩展、包含超过 2,000 个候选模型的新大规模基准。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce *CARvE*, a contrastive embedding approach for efficient continual model routing via domain-stratified coreset replay and checkpoint-based anchoring.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入 *CARvE*，一种通过域分层核心集重放与检查点锚定实现高效持续模型路由的对比嵌入方法。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical results and ablations show that CARvE significantly outperforms zero-shot retrieval, fine-tuning, and adapter-merging baselines in model, family, and domain-level accuracy.
sentences.zh: 大量实证结果与消融表明，CARvE 在模型、家族与域级精度上显著优于零样本检索、微调与适配器合并基线。

title_en: Continual Segmentation under Joint Nonstationarity
title_zh: 联合非平稳性下的持续分割

sentences.en: Evolving data streams induce joint nonstationarity in continual semantic segmentation, where semantic classes, input distributions, and supervision availability change simultaneously over time.
sentences.zh: 演化的数据流在持续语义分割中诱导联合非平稳性，其中语义类别、输入分布与监督可用性随时间同时变化。

sentences.en: This setting reflects practical structured prediction systems, yet remains largely unexplored in prior continual learning work, which typically studies these factors in isolation.
sentences.zh: 这一设定反映了现实的结构化预测系统，但在先前的持续学习工作中仍在很大程度上未被探索，那些工作通常单独研究这些因素。

sentences.en: We formalize continual segmentation under coupled class, domain, and label shifts and investigate learning in heterogeneous dense prediction environments with limited annotations and abundant unlabeled data.
sentences.zh: 我们将耦合的类别、域与标签偏移下的持续分割形式化，并在标注有限、无标签数据丰富的异构稠密预测环境中研究学习。

sentences.en: To address instability and overfitting arising from few-shot supervision under distribution drift, we introduce gradient-adaptive stabilization, a parameter-wise regularization mechanism implemented via gradient-scaled stochastic perturbations that promotes a principled stability–plasticity tradeoff.
sentences.zh: 为应对分布漂移下少样本监督引起的不稳定与过拟合，我们引入梯度自适应稳定化（gradient-adaptive stabilization），一种通过梯度缩放的随机扰动实现的逐参数正则化机制，促进有原则的稳定-可塑权衡。

sentences.en: We further leverage unlabeled data through semi-supervised learning and introduce prototype anchored supervision that validates pseudo-labels via joint confidence and prototype consistency.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过半监督学习利用无标签数据，并引入原型锚定监督，通过联合置信度与原型一致性验证伪标签。

sentences.en: Together, these mechanisms enable learning under joint nonstationarity in continual segmentation.
sentences.zh: 这些机制共同使得在持续分割的联合非平稳下学习成为可能。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical evaluation across class-incremental, domain-incremental, and few-shot regimes demonstrates consistent improvements over prior methods in heterogeneous structured prediction settings.
sentences.zh: 跨类别增量、域增量与少样本情境的大量实证评估表明，在异构结构化预测设定中，相较于先前方法取得了一致的改进。

sentences.en: Our results expose fundamental failure modes of existing continual segmentation approaches and provide insight into learning robust dense predictors in dynamically evolving environments.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果暴露了现有持续分割方法的根本性失败模式，并为在动态演化环境中学习稳健稠密预测器提供了洞见。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/prinshul/JASCL.git.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/prinshul/JASCL.git 获取。

title_en: Continuity-Regularized Flow Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 用于离线强化学习的连续性正则化流匹配

sentences.en: Flow-matching policies have recently emerged as a powerful class of generative models for offline reinforcement learning (RL), capable of capturing complex, multi-modal action distributions from static datasets.
sentences.zh: 流匹配策略近来已成为离线强化学习（RL）中最强大的生成模型类别之一，能够从静态数据集中捕获复杂、多模态的动作分布。

sentences.en: However, standard training objectives are largely agnostic to the global properties of the generative path, permitting learned vector fields that are irregular and unstable, which can hinder performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，标准训练目标在很大程上对生成路径的全局性质视而不见，允许所学向量场不规则且不稳定，这可能阻碍性能。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce PDE-regularized Q-Learning (PQL), a novel algorithm that addresses this limitation by imposing a principled structure on the entire probability flow.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入 PDE 正则化的 Q 学习（PQL），一种通过在整个概率流上施加有原则结构来解决这一局限的新算法。

sentences.en: PQL makes two synergistic contributions: first, a partial differential equation based regularizer derived from the continuity equation promotes global smoothness and stability on the flow.
sentences.zh: PQL 做出两项协同贡献：第一，一个源自连续性方程的基于偏微分方程的正则化器，促进流上的全局光滑性与稳定性。

sentences.en: Second, to solve the complex optimization problem introduced by this regularizer, we propose a Beta-distributed timestep sampling strategy that focuses learning on the critical trajectory segments where the trade-off between imitation and smoothness is most acute.
sentences.zh: 第二，为解决该正则化器引入的复杂优化问题，我们提出一种 Beta 分布时间步采样策略，将学习聚焦于模仿与光滑性之间权衡最尖锐的关键轨迹段。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that by structuring the generative journey and not just its destination, PQL achieves state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of challenging offline RL tasks.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们证明，通过结构化生成之旅（而不仅仅是其目的地），PQL 在广泛具有挑战性的离线 RL 任务上取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: Continuous Diffusion Models Can Obey Formal Syntax
title_zh: 连续扩散模型能够遵守形式语法

sentences.en: Diffusion language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models due to their global, non-causal generation process, but their continuous latent dynamics make discrete constraints---e.g., the output should be a JSON file that matches a given schema---difficult to impose.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型由于其全局、非因果的生成过程，成为自回归模型的一个有前景的替代选择，但其连续的潜在动力学使离散约束——例如输出应该是一个匹配给定模式的 JSON 文件——难以施加。

sentences.en: We introduce a training-free guidance method for steering continuous diffusion language models to satisfy formal syntactic constraints expressed using regular expressions.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种免训练的引导方法，用于引导连续扩散语言模型满足用正则表达式表达的正式语法约束。

sentences.en: Our approach constructs an analytic score estimating the probability that a latent state decodes to a valid string accepted by a given regular expression, and uses its gradient to guide sampling, _without_ training auxiliary classifiers.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法构建一个解析分数，估计一个潜在状态解码为被给定正则表达式接受的合法字符串的概率，并用其梯度引导采样，*无需*训练辅助分类器。

sentences.en: The denoising process targets the base model conditioned on syntactic validity.
sentences.zh: 去噪过程以受语法有效性约束的基础模型为目标。

sentences.en: We implement our method in Diffinity on top of the PLAID diffusion model and evaluate it on 180 regular-expression constraints over JSON and natural-language benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在 PLAID 扩散模型之上的 Diffinity 中实现了我们的方法，并在 JSON 与自然语言基准上的 180 个正则表达式约束上进行了评估。

sentences.en: Diffinity achieves 68-96\% constraint satisfaction while incurring only a small perplexity cost relative to unconstrained sampling,  outperforming autoregressive constrained decoding in both constraint satisfaction and output quality.
sentences.zh: Diffinity 实现了 68-96\% 的约束满足率，同时相对于无约束采样仅付出很小的困惑度代价，在约束满足率与输出质量上都优于自回归约束解码。

sentences.en: Diffinity is open-sourced at github.com/large-loris-models/Diffinity.
sentences.zh: Diffinity 已在 github.com/large-loris-models/Diffinity 开源。

title_en: Continuous Variable Hamiltonian Learning at Heisenberg Limit via Displacement-Random Unitary Transformation
title_zh: 通过位移–随机酉变换实现海森堡极限下的连续变量哈密顿量学习

sentences.en: Characterizing continuous-variable (CV) Hamiltonians can be formulated as Hamiltonian learning under quantum measurement constraints: finite operator coefficients are inferred from noisy measurement outcomes obtained by probing an infinite-dimensional system.
sentences.zh: 表征连续变量（CV）哈密顿量可以被表述为量子测量约束下的哈密顿学习：从探测无限维系统获得的含噪声测量结果中推断有限算子系数。

sentences.en: Existing Heisenberg-limited CV protocols are often limited to low-order structures, vulnerable to noise, or unresolved for generic multi-mode settings.
sentences.zh: 现有的 Heisenberg 极限 CV 协议常常局限于低阶结构，容易受噪声影响，或在一般的多模设定中尚未解决。

sentences.en: We introduce Displacement-Random Unitary Transformation (D-RUT), an active data acquisition protocol with pre-specified probes and number-preserving transformations that reduce finite-order bosonic Hamiltonian learning to polynomial recovery.
sentences.zh: 我们引入位移-随机幺正变换（D-RUT），一种主动数据采集协议，带有预先指定的探针与保持粒子数的变换，将有限阶玻色子哈密顿学习归结为多项式恢复。

sentences.en: We prove Heisenberg-limited total evolution time with robustness to state preparation and measurement (SPAM) errors, and develop hierarchical multi-mode coefficient recovery with better statistical efficiency than simultaneous estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了 Heisenberg 极限的总演化时间，对态制备与测量（SPAM）误差具有稳健性，并开发了比同时估计具有更好统计效率的层次化多模系数恢复。

sentences.en: We also extend D-RUT to first-quantized Hamiltonian coefficient learning, and numerical experiments on single- and multi-mode nonlinear systems validate the predicted Heisenberg scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们还将 D-RUT 扩展到第一量子化的哈密顿系数学习，单模与多模非线性系统的数值实验验证了所预测的 Heisenberg 缩放。

title_en: Continuous Viewpoint Adaptation for Single View 3D Object Reconstruction
title_zh: 用于单视图三维物体重建的连续视角适配

sentences.en: Single-view 3D object reconstruction presents a formidable challenge in computer vision due to the inherent limitations of information obtainable from a solitary viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 单视图 3D 物体重建对计算机视觉构成一个艰巨的挑战，因为单一视点可获信息存在固有局限。

sentences.en: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) inspired approaches perform a feed-forward way of learning a neural network that predicts 3D Gaussians which compose the 3D object, given a single image.
sentences.zh: 近期受 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）启发的方法以前馈方式学习一个神经网络，它在给定单张图像的情况下预测构成 3D 物体的 3D 高斯。

sentences.en: However, they often struggle with occlusions and exhibit high sensitivity to small changes in input viewpoint, leading to inconsistencies and blurry artifacts in novel view renderings.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们常常难以应对遮挡，并对输入视点的微小变化高度敏感，导致新视角渲染中出现不一致与模糊伪影。

sentences.en: Our method leverages 3DGS and introduces a new learning scheme that continuously adapts to input viewpoints.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法利用 3DGS，并引入一种持续适应输入视点的全新学习方案。

sentences.en: To address inherent continuity of camera viewpoints that are represented by polar and azimuthal angles, we use Neural Ordinary Differential Equations to continuously model filter subspace of neural network, thus seamlessly embedding inductive bias of perspective distortions into its structure.
sentences.zh: 为处理用极角与方位角表示的相机视点的固有连续性，我们使用神经常微分方程连续地建模神经网络的滤波器子空间，从而将透视畸变的归纳偏置无缝嵌入其结构中。

sentences.en: By continuously adapting to view-specific features, our approach fosters view consistency in 3D reconstruction, allowing better coherency and accuracy across different angles.
sentences.zh: 通过持续适应视点特定特征，我们的方法促进 3D 重建中的视点一致性，使不同角度之间具有更好的连贯性与精度。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that our model outperforms previous methods on multiple single-view 3D reconstruction benchmark datasets and excels in extrapolating to unseen camera angles and categories.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的模型在多个单视图 3D 重建基准数据集上优于先前方法，并且在外推到未见相机角度与类别方面表现出色。

title_en: Continuous-Time Piecewise-Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
title_zh: 连续时间分段线性循环神经网络

sentences.en: In dynamical systems reconstruction (DSR) we aim to recover the dynamical system (DS) underlying observed time series.
sentences.zh: 在动力系统重建（DSR）中，我们的目标是恢复底层观测时间序列的动力系统（DS）。

sentences.en: Specifically, we aim to learn a generative surrogate model which approximates the underlying, data-generating DS, and recreates its long-term properties (`climate statistics').
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的目标是学习一个生成式代理模型，它近似底层、生成数据的 DS，并复现其长期性质（“气候统计”）。

sentences.en: In scientific and medical areas, in particular, these models need to be mechanistically tractable -- through their mathematical analysis we would like to obtain insight into the recovered system's workings.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在科学与医学领域，这些模型需要在机制上可处理——通过它们的数学分析，我们希望获得对所恢复系统运作方式的洞见。

sentences.en: Piecewise-linear (PL), ReLU-based RNNs (PLRNNs) have a strong track-record in this regard, representing SOTA DSR models while allowing mathematical insight by virtue of their PL design.
sentences.zh: 分段线性（PL）、基于 ReLU 的 RNN（PLRNN）在这方面有着坚实的记录，代表了最先进的 DSR 模型，同时凭借其 PL 设计允许数学洞见。

sentences.en: However, all current PLRNN variants are *discrete-time maps*.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前所有 PLRNN 变体都是*离散时间映射*。

sentences.en: This is in disaccord with the assumed continuous-time nature of most physical and biological processes, and makes it hard to accommodate data arriving at *irregular* temporal intervals.
sentences.zh: 这与大多数物理与生物过程假定的连续时间本质相抵触，并使得容纳以*不规则*时间间隔到达的数据变得困难。

sentences.en: Neural ODEs are one solution, but they do not reach the DSR performance of PLRNNs and often lack their tractability.
sentences.zh: 神经 ODE 是一种解决方案，但它们达不到 PLRNN 的 DSR 性能，并且常常缺乏其可处理性。

sentences.en: Here we develop theory for *continuous-time* PLRNNs (cPLRNNs): We present a novel algorithm for training and simulating such models, bypassing numerical integration by efficiently exploiting their PL structure.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们为*连续时间* PLRNN（cPLRNN）发展理论：我们提出一种训练与模拟此类模型的新算法，通过高效利用其 PL 结构来绕过数值积分。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate how important topological objects like equilibria or limit cycles can be determined semi-analytically in trained models.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步展示了如何在训练好的模型中半解析地确定均衡或极限环等重要拓扑对象。

sentences.en: We compare cPLRNNs to both their discrete-time cousins as well as Neural ODEs on DSR benchmarks, including systems with discontinuities which come with hard thresholds.
sentences.zh: 我们将 cPLRNN 与其离散时间同类以及神经 ODE 在 DSR 基准上进行比较，包括带有陡峭阈值的含间断系统。

title_en: CONTINUUM: Restoring the Contiguous Tensor Abstraction Efficiently for Dynamic AI Workloads via Hardware Virtualization
title_zh: CONTINUUM：通过硬件虚拟化为动态 AI 工作负载高效恢复连续张量抽象

sentences.en: Emerging LLM workloads demand extreme mem- ory agility.
sentences.zh: 新兴的 LLM 工作负载要求极端的存储敏捷性。

sentences.en: However, state-of-the-art inference systems (e.g., vLLM) rely on software-defined paging, which sacrifices the contiguous tensor abstraction.
sentences.zh: 然而，最先进的推理系统（例如 vLLM）依赖软件定义的分页，这牺牲了连续张量抽象。

sentences.en: This rigid interface exposes fragmen- tation complexity to developers, imposing a se- vere engineering burden that stifles algorithmic innovation.
sentences.zh: 这种僵化的接口将碎片化复杂性暴露给开发者，施加了严重的工程负担，扼杀了算法创新。

sentences.en: We introduce CONTINUUM, a tensor memory virtualization subsystem implemented as a PyTorch extension.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 CONTINUUM，一个作为 PyTorch 扩展实现的张量存储虚拟化子系统。

sentences.en: By bypassing serialized OS bottlenecks via a lightweight GPU driver ex- tension, CONTINUUM can significantly reduce the mapping costs by orders of magnitude—from milliseconds to microseconds.
sentences.zh: 通过轻量级 GPU 驱动扩展绕过串行化的 OS 瓶颈，CONTINUUM 可以将映射成本大幅降低数个数量级——从毫秒级到微秒级。

sentences.en: Built atop this low-latency API, CONTINUUM provides Elastic Tensor, with a set of flexible tensor operations that natively supports complex memory dynamics and zero-copy topological aliasing.
sentences.zh: 在这一低延迟 API 之上，CONTINUUM 提供弹性张量（Elastic Tensor），并带有一组灵活的张量操作，原生支持复杂的存储动态与零拷贝拓扑别名。

sentences.en: Evaluations demonstrate that CONTINUUM achieves signifi- cantly higher throughput across diverse dynamic scenarios, effectively democratizing the imple- mentation of next-generation LLM applications.
sentences.zh: 评估表明，CONTINUUM 在多样的动态场景中实现了显著更高的吞吐量，有效地使下一代 LLM 应用的实现大众化。

title_en: Contractive Anchor Resolvent Diffusion for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
title_zh: 用于不完整多视图聚类的收缩锚点预解式扩散

sentences.en: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering (IMVC) is affected not only by missing feature values, but also by the degradation of relational structure induced by missing views.
sentences.zh: 不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）不仅受缺失特征值的影响，还受缺失视图诱导的关系结构退化的影响。

sentences.en: Many graph-based approaches either rely on costly data imputation or adopt first-order fusion mechanisms, which can be viewed as shallow low-pass filters with limited spectral selectivity.
sentences.zh: 许多基于图的方法要么依赖代价高昂的数据插补，要么采用一阶融合机制，后者可以被视为具有有限谱选择性的浅层低通滤波器。

sentences.en: As a result, they may be insufficient to distinguish latent consensus structure from view-specific structural variations.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们可能不足以将潜在共识结构与视图特定的结构变化区分开来。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we reformulate IMVC from a spectral filtering perspective and propose \textbf{C}ontractive \textbf{A}nchor \textbf{R}esolvent \textbf{D}iffusion (\textbf{CARD}), a scalable framework for structural refinement without explicit view imputation.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们从谱滤波的视角重新表述 IMVC，并提出**C**ontractive **A**nchor **R**esolvent **D**iffusion（**CARD**），一个无需显式视图插补即可进行结构精炼的可扩展框架。

sentences.en: CARD constructs a unified anchor-induced hypergraph from observed sample--anchor relations and derives a high-order resolvent diffusion operator that acts as a rational spectral filter.
sentences.zh: CARD 从观测的样本-锚点关系中构建一个统一的锚点诱发的超图，并推导一个作为有理谱滤波器运作的高阶预解式扩散算子。

sentences.en: This operator enhances the relative response of consensus-dominant modes while attenuating view-specific variations.
sentences.zh: 该算子增强共识主导模态的相对响应，同时衰减视图特定的变化。

sentences.en: We further derive a compact implicit solver that couples similarity learning and clustering without materializing dense matrices, and provide a conditional local refinement analysis under spectral-gap and local-stability assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步推导一个紧凑的隐式求解器，它在无需具体化稠密矩阵的情况下耦合相似性学习与聚类，并在谱间隔与局部稳定性假设下提供条件性的局部精炼分析。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks, including large-scale datasets, show that CARD achieves competitive performance while scaling linearly in \(N\) for a fixed anchor budget.
sentences.zh: 在包括大规模数据集在内的八个基准上的大量实验表明，CARD 在固定锚点预算下以线性于 N 的复杂度取得有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: The code for our method is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/Whale-Waves/CARD}.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法代码公开于 \url{https://github.com/Whale-Waves/CARD}。

title_en: Contrastive Diffusion Alignment: Learning Structured Latents for Controllable Generation
title_zh: 对比扩散对齐：为可控生成学习结构化潜在表示

sentences.en: Diffusion models excel at generation, but their latent spaces are high dimensional and not explicitly organized for interpretation or control.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型擅长生成，但它们的潜空间是高维的，并未为解释或控制而显式组织。

sentences.en: We introduce ConDA (Contrastive Diffusion Alignment), a plug-and-play geometry layer that applies contrastive learning to pretrained diffusion latents using auxiliary variables (e.g., time, stimulation parameters, facial action units).
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ConDA（对比扩散对齐），一个即插即用的几何层，它利用辅助变量（例如时间、刺激参数、面部动作单元）对预训练的扩散潜变量应用对比学习。

sentences.en: ConDA learns a low-dimensional embedding whose directions align with underlying dynamical factors, consistent with recent contrastive learning results on structured and disentangled representations.
sentences.zh: ConDA 学习一个低维嵌入，其方向与底层的动力学因子对齐，这与近期关于结构化与解耦表示的对比学习结果一致。

sentences.en: In this embedding, simple nonlinear trajectories support smooth interpolation, extrapolation, and counterfactual editing while rendering remains in the original diffusion space.
sentences.zh: 在此嵌入中，简单的非线性轨迹支持平滑插值、外推与反事实编辑，而渲染仍保持在原始扩散空间中。

sentences.en: ConDA separates editing and rendering by lifting embedding trajectories back to diffusion latents with a neighborhood-preserving kNN decoder and is robust across inversion solvers.
sentences.zh: ConDA 通过用保邻域 kNN 解码器将嵌入轨迹提升回扩散潜变量，将编辑与渲染分离，并且跨求逆求解器保持稳健。

sentences.en: Across fluid dynamics, neural calcium imaging, therapeutic neurostimulation, facial expression dynamics, and monkey motor cortex activity, ConDA yields more interpretable and controllable latent structure than linear traversals and conditioning-based baselines, indicating that diffusion latents encode dynamics-relevant structure that can be exploited by an explicit contrastive geometry layer.
sentences.zh: 在流体动力学、神经钙成像、治疗性神经刺激、面部表情动力学与猴运动皮层活动上，ConDA 产生的潜在结构比线性遍历与基于条件的基线更可解释且更可控，这表明扩散潜变量编码了可通过显式对比几何层加以利用的动力学相关结构。

title_en: Contrastive Flow Map Matching
title_zh: 对比流映射匹配

sentences.en: Flow map matching (FMM) enables one- and few-step sampling for diffusion-style generation, yet its performance is often hindered by the mismatch between ground-truth training transitions and model-induced flow maps.
sentences.zh: 流图匹配（FMM）能够实现扩散式生成的单步与少步采样，但其性能常常受到真实训练转移与模型诱导流图之间错配的阻碍。

sentences.en: We propose **Contrastive Flow Map Matching (CFMM)**, a principled framework that explicitly aligns FMM training with practical sampling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **对比流图匹配（CFMM）**，一个显式地对齐 FMM 训练与实际采样的有原则框架。

sentences.en: Our approach is motivated by a joint-KL decomposition on the reverse KL divergence, which decomposes the distributional gap into a marginal mismatch over intermediate states and a conditional mismatch in endpoint reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法由反向 KL 散度上的联合 KL 分解驱动，该分解将分布差距分解为中间状态上的边际错配与端点重建中的条件错配。

sentences.en: This analysis motivates two complementary objectives: average-velocity regression for marginal alignment and a sampling-aligned InfoNCE contrastive loss for conditional refinement.
sentences.zh: 这一分析促使两个互补的目标：用于边际对齐的平均速度回归，以及用于条件精炼的采样对齐 InfoNCE 对比损失。

sentences.en: CFMM is a training-only plug-in for pre-trained FMMs, incurs no inference-time overhead, and supports training FMMs from scratch.
sentences.zh: CFMM 是预训练 FMM 的仅训练插件，不产生推理时开销，并支持从零训练 FMM。

sentences.en: Experiments on CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and LSUN across multiple FMM baselines demonstrate consistent improvements in fidelity and perceptual quality with only modest additional training cost.
sentences.zh: 在多个 FMM 基线上对 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 与 LSUN 的实验表明，在仅支出适度额外训练成本的情况下，保真度与感知质量获得了一致的改进。

title_en: Contrastive Geometric Learning Unlocks Unified Structure- and Ligand-Based Drug Design
title_zh: 对比几何学习实现统一的基于结构与配体的药物设计

sentences.en: Structure-based and ligand-based computational drug design have traditionally relied on disjoint data sources and modeling assumptions, limiting their joint use at scale.
sentences.zh: 基于结构与基于配体的计算药物设计在传统上依赖不相交的数据来源与建模假设，限制了它们在大规模下的联合使用。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce **Con**trastive **G**eometric **L**earning for **U**nified Computational **D**rug D**e**sign (ConGLUDe), a single contrastive geometric model that unifies structure- and ligand-based training.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入**对**比**几**何**学**习用于**统**一计算**药**物设**计**（ConGLUDe），一个统一结构与基于配体训练的比较几何模型。

sentences.en: ConGLUDe couples a geometric protein encoder that produces whole-protein representations and implicit embeddings of predicted binding sites with a fast ligand encoder, removing the need for pre-defined pockets.
sentences.zh: ConGLUDe 将一个产生全蛋白表示与预测结合位点隐式嵌入的几何蛋白编码器，与一个快速配体编码器耦合，从而消除了对预定义口袋的需求。

sentences.en: By aligning ligands with both global protein representations and multiple candidate binding sites through contrastive learning, ConGLUDe supports ligand-conditioned pocket prediction in addition to virtual screening and target fishing, while being trained jointly on protein-ligand complexes and large-scale bioactivity data.
sentences.zh: 通过对比学习将配体与全局蛋白表示及多个候选结合位点对齐，ConGLUDe 除支持虚拟筛选与靶点查找外，还支持配体条件的口袋预测，同时在蛋白-配体复合体与大规模活性数据上联合训练。

sentences.en: Across diverse benchmarks, ConGLUDe achieves competitive zero-shot virtual screening performance, substantially outperforms existing methods on a challenging target fishing task, and demonstrates state-of-the-art ligand-conditioned pocket selection.
sentences.zh: 在多样基准上，ConGLUDe 取得了有竞争力的零样本虚拟筛选性能，在具有挑战性的靶点查找任务上大幅优于现有方法，并展示了最先进的配体条件口袋选择。

sentences.en: These results highlight the advantages of unified structure-ligand training and position ConGLUDe as a step toward general-purpose foundation models for drug discovery.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了统一结构-配体训练的优势，并将 ConGLUDe 定位为迈向药物发现通用基础模型的一步。

title_en: Contrastive Order Learning: A General Framework for Ordinal Regression
title_zh: 对比顺序学习：序数回归的通用框架

sentences.en: We propose contrastive order learning (ConOrd), a contrastive learning framework for ordinal regression that integrates the strengths of contrastive learning and order learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出对比顺序学习（ConOrd），一个用于序数回归的对比学习框架，它整合了对比学习与顺序学习的优势。

sentences.en: While contrastive learning effectively leverages all samples in a batch, it typically ignores the inherent ordering among rank labels.
sentences.zh: 虽然对比学习有效地利用了批次中的所有样本，但它通常忽略了秩标签之间固有的排序。

sentences.en: Conversely, order learning explicitly models label ordinality but often relies on local, margin-based comparisons, limiting its ability to capture global ordinal structure.
sentences.zh: 相反，顺序学习显式地建模标签的序数性，但常常依赖局部的、基于间隔的比较，限制其捕获全局序数结构的能力。

sentences.en: ConOrd addresses these limitations by introducing a contrastive order loss with soft affinity and disparity weights based on rank differences, enabling fine-grained modeling of ordinal relationships across all sample pairs within a batch.
sentences.zh: ConOrd 通过引入一种带基于秩差异的软亲和力与差异权重的对比顺序损失来解决这些局限，从而能够在批次内所有样本对之间进行序数关系的细粒度建模。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on a range of ordinal regression tasks, including facial age estimation, blind image quality assessment, and blind video quality assessment, demonstrate that ConOrd consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance and generalizes well across diverse ordinal regression scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在一系列序数回归任务（包括面部年龄估计、盲图像质量评估与盲视频质量评估）上的大量实验表明，ConOrd 一致地取得最先进的性能，并在多样序数回归场景中泛化良好。

sentences.en: The source code is available at https://github.com/cwlee00/ConOrd.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/cwlee00/ConOrd 获取。

title_en: Contrastive Reasoning Alignment: Reinforcement Learning from Hidden Representations
title_zh: 对比推理对齐：从隐藏表征中进行强化学习

sentences.en: We propose CRAFT, a red-teaming alignment framework that leverages model reasoning capabilities and hidden representations to improve robustness against jailbreak attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CRAFT，一个红队对齐框架，它利用模型推理能力与隐藏表示来提升对越狱攻击的稳健性。

sentences.en: Unlike prior defenses that operate primarily at the output level, CRAFT aligns large reasoning models to generate safety-aware reasoning traces by explicitly optimizing objectives defined over the hidden state space.
sentences.zh: 与主要在输出层面运作的先前防御不同，CRAFT 通过显式优化定义在隐藏状态空间上的目标，来对齐大型推理模型以生成安全感知的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: Methodologically, CRAFT integrates contrastive representation learning with reinforcement learning to separate safe and unsafe reasoning trajectories, yielding a latent-space geometry that supports robust, reasoning-level safety alignment.
sentences.zh: 在方法上，CRAFT 将对比表示学习与强化学习相结合，以分离安全与不安全的推理轨迹，产生一种支持稳健的、推理级安全对齐的潜空间几何。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that incorporating latent–textual consistency into GRPO eliminates superficially aligned policies by ruling them out as local optima.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们表明，将潜在-文本一致性纳入 GRPO，通过将表面对齐的策略排除为局部最优，消除了它们。

sentences.en: Empirically, we evaluate CRAFT on multiple safety benchmarks using two strong reasoning models, Qwen3-4B-Thinking and R1-Distill-Llama-8B, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art defenses such as IPO and SafeKey.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们使用两个强推理模型 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 与 R1-Distill-Llama-8B，在多个安全基准上评估了 CRAFT，它一致地优于 IPO 与 SafeKey 等最先进防御。

sentences.en: Notably,  CRAFT delivers an average **79.0%** improvement in reasoning safety and **87.7%** improvement in final-response safety over the base models, demonstrating the effectiveness of hidden-space reasoning alignment.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，CRAFT 相对于基础模型在推理安全上平均提升了 **79.0%**，在最终响应安全上平均提升了 **87.7%**，证明了隐藏空间推理对齐的有效性。

title_en: Contrastive Representation Regularization for Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: 视觉–语言–动作模型的对比表征正则化

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robot manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）的丰富表示，在机器人操作中展现出强大的能力。

sentences.en: However, their representations arguably remain suboptimal, lacking sensitivity to robotic signals such as control actions and proprioceptive information.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的表示可以说仍然是次优的，缺乏对控制动作与本体感受信息等机器人信号的敏感性。

sentences.en: To address the issue, we introduce Robot State-aware Contrastive Loss (RS-CL), a simple and effective representation regularization for VLA models, designed to bridge the gap between VLM representations and robotic signals.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入机器人状态感知对比损失（RS-CL），一种用于 VLA 模型的简单而有效的表示正则化方法，旨在弥合 VLM 表示与机器人信号之间的差距。

sentences.en: In particular, RS-CL aligns the representations more closely with the robot's proprioceptive states by using relative distances between the states as soft supervision.
sentences.zh: 特别地，RS-CL 通过使用状态之间的相对距离作为软监督，使表示与机器人的本体感受状态更紧密地对齐。

sentences.en: Complementing the original action prediction objective, RS-CL enhances control-relevant representation learning, while being lightweight and fully compatible with standard VLA training pipelines.
sentences.zh: 作为原始动作预测目标的补充，RS-CL 增强了与控制相关的表示学习，同时保持轻量，并与标准的 VLA 训练流程完全兼容。

sentences.en: Our empirical results demonstrate that RS-CL substantially improves the performance of state-of-the-art VLA models; it pushes the prior art to 69.7% achieving the state-of-the-art performance on the RoboCasa-Kitchen benchmark, and boosts success rates from 45.0% to 58.3% on challenging real-robot manipulation tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证结果表明，RS-CL 大幅提升了最先进 VLA 模型的性能；它将先前最先进水平推到 69.7%，在 RoboCasa-Kitchen 基准上取得最先进性能，并在具有挑战性的真实机器人操作任务上将成功率从 45.0% 提升到 58.3%。

title_en: Contrastive Spectral Rectification: Test-Time Defense towards Zero-shot Adversarial Robustness of CLIP
title_zh: 对比谱校正：面向 CLIP 零样本对抗鲁棒性的测试时防御

sentences.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to adversarial examples (AEs).
sentences.zh: 诸如 CLIP 之类的视觉-语言模型（VLM）已展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力，但高度容易受到对抗样本（AE）的攻击。

sentences.en: While test-time defenses are promising, existing methods fail to provide sufficient robustness against strong attacks and are often hampered by high inference latency and task-specific applicability.
sentences.zh: 虽然测试时防御很有前景，但现有方法无法提供对抗强攻击的足够稳健性，并且常常受高推理延迟与任务特定适用性的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we start by investigating the intrinsic properties of AEs, which reveals that AEs exhibit severe feature inconsistency under progressive frequency attenuation.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们首先研究 AE 的内在性质，发现 AE 在渐进式频率衰减下表现出严重的特征不一致。

sentences.en: We further attribute this to the model's inherent spectral bias.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将其归因于模型固有的谱偏差。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose an efficient test-time defense named Contrastive Spectral Rectification (CSR).
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们提出一种高效的测试时防御，称为对比谱矫正（CSR）。

sentences.en: CSR optimizes a rectification perturbation to realign the input with the natural manifold under a spectral-guided contrastive objective, which is applied input-adaptively.
sentences.zh: CSR 在谱引导的对比目标下优化一个矫正扰动，将输入重新对齐到自然流形，并以输入自适应的方式应用。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across 16 classification benchmarks demonstrate that CSR outperforms the SOTA by an average of 18.1% against strong APGD with modest inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 跨 16 个分类基准的大量实验表明，以适度的推理开销，CSR 在对抗强 APGD 方面平均优于最先进方法 18.1%。

sentences.en: Furthermore, CSR exhibits broad applicability across diverse visual tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，CSR 在多样视觉任务中展现出广泛的适用性。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Summu77/CSR.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Summu77/CSR 获取。

title_en: Contrastive Symbolic Regression: Aligned Representations, Adaptive Prediction, and Diverse Ensembles
title_zh: 对比符号回归：对齐表征、自适应预测与多样化集成

sentences.en: Existing symbolic regression approaches primarily focus on learning explicit input-output mappings, often neglecting relational structures among data instances.
sentences.zh: 现有的符号回归方法主要聚焦于学习显式的输入-输出映射，常常忽略数据实例之间的关系结构。

sentences.en: This paper introduces Contrastive Symbolic Regression (CSR), a feature-construction-based symbolic regression approach that integrates evolutionary feature construction with contrastive learning to shape a representation space where geometric proximity reflects similarity in the target space.
sentences.zh: 本文引入对比符号回归（CSR），一种基于特征构造的符号回归方法，它将进化特征构造与对比学习相结合，以塑造一个几何邻近性反映目标空间相似性的表示空间。

sentences.en: CSR employs a contrastive objective that optimizes a linear transformation of constructed features, with a closed-form solution for aligning the feature space with the target space.
sentences.zh: CSR 采用一个优化所构造特征线性变换的对比目标，并具有用于将特征空间与目标空间对齐的闭式解。

sentences.en: The constructed features are applied to K-nearest neighbor regression, where we propose an efficient leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) method that addresses standard LOOCV's computational expense and adaptively selects the neighborhood size, along with a linear-rank weighted K-nearest neighbor variant for faithful assessment of representation quality during evolution.
sentences.zh: 所构造的特征被应用于 K 近邻回归，其中我们提出一种高效的留一交叉验证（LOOCV）方法，它解决了标准 LOOCV 的计算开销并自适应地选择邻域大小，同时提出一种线性秩加权 K 近邻变体，用于在进化期间忠实评估表示质量。

sentences.en: A determinantal point process-based ensemble selection mechanism further enhances robustness by jointly considering model quality and diversity.
sentences.zh: 一个基于行列式点过程的集成选择机制通过联合考虑模型质量与多样性，进一步增强了稳健性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 58 real-world regression datasets demonstrate that CSR consistently surpasses both traditional symbolic regression and modern machine learning counterparts, highlighting CSR as a promising direction for interpretable and effective regression modeling.
sentences.zh: 在 58 个真实世界回归数据集上的大量实验表明，CSR 一致地超越传统符号回归与现代机器学习对应方法，凸显了 CSR 作为可解释且有效回归建模的一个有前景方向。

title_en: Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization
title_zh: 对比式由弱到强泛化

sentences.en: Weak-to-strong generalization provides a promising paradigm for scaling large language models (LLMs) by training stronger models on samples from aligned weaker ones, without requiring human feedback or explicit reward modeling.
sentences.zh: 弱到强泛化通过在对齐的较弱模型生成的样本上训练更强模型，为扩展大语言模型（LLM）提供了一个有前景的范式，而无需人工反馈或显式奖励建模。

sentences.en: However, its robustness and generalization are hindered by the noise and biases in weak-model outputs, which limit its applicability in practice.
sentences.zh: 然而，其稳健性与泛化受到弱模型输出中噪声与偏差的阻碍，这限制了它在实践中的适用性。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we leverage implicit rewards, which approximate explicit rewards through log-likelihood ratios, and reveal their structural equivalence with Contrastive Decoding (CD), a decoding strategy shown to reduce noise in LLM generation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们利用隐式奖励，它通过对数似然比近似显式奖励，并揭示它们与对比解码（CD）的结构等价性，后者是一种已被证明能减少 LLM 生成噪声的解码策略。

sentences.en: Building on this connection, we propose \textbf{Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization (ConG)}, a framework that employs contrastive decoding between pre- and post-alignment weak models to generate higher-quality samples.
sentences.zh: 基于这一联系，我们提出 \textbf{Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization (ConG)}，一个在对齐前与对齐后的弱模型之间采用对比解码以生成更高质量样本的框架。

sentences.en: This approach enables more reliable capability transfer, denoising, and improved robustness, substantially mitigating the limitations of traditional weak-to-strong methods.
sentences.zh: 这一方法实现了更可靠的能力迁移、去噪与稳健性提升，大幅缓解了传统弱到强方法的局限。

sentences.en: Empirical results across different model families confirm consistent improvements, demonstrating the generality and effectiveness of ConG. Taken together, our findings highlight the potential of ConG to advance weak-to-strong generalization and provide a promising pathway toward AGI.
sentences.zh: 跨不同模型家族的实证结果证实了一致的改进，证明了 ConG 的通用性与有效性。综合而言，我们的发现凸显了 ConG 推进弱到强泛化的潜力，并为通往 AGI 提供了一条有前景的路径。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: \url{https://github.com/jianghoucheng/ConG}
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/jianghoucheng/ConG} 获取。

title_en: ContrastiveCFG: Guiding Diffusion Sampling by Contrasting Positive and Negative Concepts
title_zh: ContrastiveCFG：通过对比正负概念引导扩散采样

sentences.en: As Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) has proven effective in conditional diffusion model sampling for improved condition alignment, many applications use a negated CFG term as a Negative Prompting (NP) to filter out unwanted features from samples.
sentences.zh: 由于无分类器引导（CFG）在条件扩散模型采样中已被证明对改善条件对齐有效，许多应用使用取反的 CFG 项作为负面提示（NP），以从样本中滤除不想要的特征。

sentences.en: However, simply negating CFG guidance creates an inverted probability distribution, often distorting samples away from the marginal distribution.
sentences.zh: 然而，简单地取反 CFG 引导会产生一个倒置的概率分布，常常使样本偏离边际分布。

sentences.en: Inspired by recent advances in conditional diffusion models for inverse problems, here we present a novel method to achieve guidance toward the given condition using contrastive loss.
sentences.zh: 受近期条件扩散模型用于逆问题的最新进展的启发，在此我们提出一种新方法，通过对比损失实现向给定条件的引导。

sentences.en: Specifically, our guidance term aligns or repels the denoising direction based on the given condition through contrastive loss, achieving a similar guiding effect to traditional CFG for positive conditions while overcoming the limitations of existing negative guidance methods.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的引导项通过对比损失，根据给定条件对齐或排斥去噪方向，对正条件实现了与传统 CFG 相似的引导效果，同时克服了现有负面引导方法的局限。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively injects or removes the given concepts while maintaining sample quality across diverse scenarios, from simple class conditions to complex and overlapping text prompts.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的方法在保持样本质量的同时，有效地注入或移除给定概念，涵盖从简单的类条件到复杂且重叠的文本提示等各种场景。

title_en: Contribution Weights: A Geometrical Analysis of Self-Attention Transformers
title_zh: 贡献权重：自注意力 Transformer 的几何分析

sentences.en: Analyzing attention weights has become a standard approach for interpreting the information flow of Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 分析注意力权重已成为解释大语言模型（LLM）信息流动的标准方法。

sentences.en: However, this approach has significant limitations as it neglects the geometric properties of the value vectors being aggregated.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法有显著局限，因为它忽略了被聚合的值向量的几何性质。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Contribution Weights}, a projection-based metric that quantifies a token's influence by accounting for it's attention weight, value magnitude, and directional alignment with the layer output.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们引入\emph{Contribution Weights}，一个基于投影的度量，它通过计入词元的注意力权重、值幅度以及与层输出的方向对齐，来量化词元的影响。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that contribution weights provide a more faithful measure of token importance, consistently outperforming attention-based metrics in identifying semantically critical tokens across different decoder-only models, tasks, and datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，贡献权重提供了更忠实的词元重要性度量，在不同的仅解码器模型、任务与数据集上，识别语义关键词元的一贯表现优于基于注意力的度量。

sentences.en: Further, our metric enables novel mechanistic analysis of \emph{attention sinks}.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的度量使得对*注意力汇聚点*（attention sinks）的新机制分析成为可能。

sentences.en: While previous work characterized sinks as passive repositories for excess attention, we reveal they serve an active functional role, suppressing information through a convex relationship between sink rate and output norm, stabilizing representations by opposing the semantic drift of low-confidence tokens.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作将汇聚点刻画为多余注意力的被动仓库，我们揭示了它们承担积极的功级角色，通过汇聚点比率与输出范数之间的凸关系抑制信息，通过抵消低置信词元的语义漂移来稳定表示。

title_en: Control Consistency Losses for Diffusion Bridges
title_zh: 扩散桥的控制一致性损失

sentences.en: Simulating the conditioned dynamics of diffusion processes, given their initial and terminal states, is an important but challenging problem in the sciences.
sentences.zh: 在给定初始与终止状态的情况下模拟扩散过程的条件动力学，是科学中的一个重要但具挑战性的问题。

sentences.en: The difficulty is particularly pronounced for rare events, for which the unconditioned dynamics rarely reach the terminal state.
sentences.zh: 这一难度在罕发事件中尤为突出，因为非条件动力学很少能到达终止状态。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a novel approach for learning diffusion bridges based on a self-consistency property of the optimal control.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种基于最优控制自一致性性质的学习扩散桥的新方法。

sentences.en: The resulting algorithm learns the conditioned dynamics in an iterative online manner, and exhibits strong performance in a range of empirical settings without requiring differentiation through simulated trajectories.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的算法以迭代在线的方式学习条件动力学，并在无需通过模拟轨迹进行微分的各种实证设定中展现强劲性能。

sentences.en: Beyond the diffusion bridge setting, we draw connections between our self-consistency framework and recent advances in the wider stochastic optimal control literature.
sentences.zh: 除扩散桥设定之外，我们在我们的自一致性框架与更广泛随机最优控制文献中的近期进展之间建立了联系。

title_en: Controllable and Explainable Personality Sliders for LLMs at Inference Time
title_zh: 大语言模型推理时可控且可解释的人格滑块

sentences.en: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with specific personas typically relies on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) or Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF); however, these methods are resource-intensive, requiring expensive data collection and distinct model training for each target personality.
sentences.zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）与特定人格对齐通常依赖监督微调（SFT）或基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）；然而，这些方法资源密集，需要为每种目标人格进行昂贵的数据收集与独立的模型训练。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a parameter-efficient framework for continuous, multi-dimensional personality control via inference-time activation steering.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一个通过推理时激活引导实现连续、多维人格控制的参数高效框架。

sentences.en: Our approach addresses the challenge of combining multiple interventions by iteratively retraining probes on the residual stream modified by prior traits, ensuring compatibility.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过在被先前特质修改的残差流上迭代重训探针来解决组合多种干预的挑战，确保兼容性。

sentences.en: Once established, these steering vectors function as modular, reusable primitives; users can instantly synthesize novel, complex personality profiles by simply adjusting steering coefficients (α) without any additional training.
sentences.zh: 一旦建立，这些引导向量便充当模块化、可重用的原语；用户只需调整转向系数（$\alpha$），即可即刻合成新颖、复杂的人格画像，而无需任何额外训练。

sentences.en: To support this, we introduce an automated pipeline that identifies optimal intervention layers via activation separation analysis and calibrates coefficients via hyperparameter optimization to maximize alignment while constraining perplexity.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一点，我们引入一条自动化流水线，它通过激活分离分析识别最优干预层，并通过超参数优化校准系数，以在对齐最大化的同时约束困惑度。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations validate individual trait shifts using an LLM-as-a-judge framework and demonstrate, via the Big Five inventory, that our method effectively modulates the model's holistic personality profile without updating base model parameters.
sentences.zh: 实证评估使用 LLM 作为评判者的框架验证了个别特质的偏移，并通过大五人格问卷（Big Five）表明，我们的方法在无需更新基础模型参数的情况下，有效调节了模型的整体人格画像。

title_en: Controllable Molecule Generation via Sparse Representation Editing: An Interpretability-Driven Perspective
title_zh: 通过稀疏表征编辑实现可控分子生成：可解释性驱动视角

sentences.en: Controllable molecule generation is crucial for diverse scientific applications, such as drug discovery and materials design.
sentences.zh: 可控分子生成对药物发现与材料设计等多样科学应用至关重要。

sentences.en: While large language models (LLMs) show great promise, their dense and entangled representations impede precise control over the generation of molecules with bespoke substructures or properties.
sentences.zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）展现出巨大前景，但它们稠密且纠缠的表示阻碍了对具有定制子结构或性质分子生成的精确控制。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Sparse Representation Editing (SpaRE), an interpretability-driven framework for fine-grained and precise control in LLM-based molecule generation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出稀疏表示编辑（SpaRE），一个用于 LLM 分子生成中进行细粒度、精确控制的可解释性驱动框架。

sentences.en: The crux of SpaRE is to learn an overcomplete sparse feature space that disentangles LLM representations into a compact set of latent features corresponding to chemically meaningful concepts.
sentences.zh: SpaRE 的关键在于学习一个过完备的稀疏特征空间，将 LLM 表示解耦为一组与化学上有意义的概念对应的紧凑潜在特征。

sentences.en: Within this space, we can directly manipulate these concept-aligned latent features to achieve (1) local control, by generating target atoms and functional groups at specified positions; and (2) global control, by customizing the overall structural and physicochemical properties within defined ranges.
sentences.zh: 在此空间中，我们可以直接操纵这些概念对齐的潜在特征，实现（1）局部控制，通过在指定位置生成目标原子与官能团；以及（2）全局控制，通过在定义范围内定制整体的结构与物理化学性质。

sentences.en: In this way, our framework advances interpretability from post-hoc analysis to actionable generative control.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，我们的框架将可解释性从事后分析推进到可操作的生成控制。

sentences.en: Experiments show that SpaRE can generate chemically desirable molecules under complex constraints in real-world scenarios, while offering mechanistic insights for quantitative structure–property analysis.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，SpaRE 能够在现实场景的复杂约束下生成化学上合乎需求的分子，同时为定量结构-性质分析提供机制性洞见。

sentences.en: The code and demo are available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_SpaRE.
sentences.zh: 代码与演示可在 https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_SpaRE 获取。

title_en: Controlled Collaboration Geometry for Personalized Federated Learning
title_zh: 用于个性化联邦学习的可控协作几何结构

sentences.en: In personalized federated learning (PFL), collaboration graphs specify model aggregation among clients.
sentences.zh: 在个性化联邦学习（PFL）中，协作图指定客户端之间的模型聚合。

sentences.en: However, without constraints on the collaboration geometry, training can drift into two degenerate regimes: global consensus or spontaneous clustering.
sentences.zh: 然而，在没有对协作几何施加约束的情况下，训练可能会漂移进入两种退化模式：全局共识或自发聚类。

sentences.en: This paper provides a unified dynamical analysis: under the same budget of representative models, collaborative PFL is more expressive and achieves higher-order approximation accuracy than clustered PFL.
sentences.zh: 本文提供了统一的动力学分析：在相同的代表性模型预算下，协作式 PFL 比聚类式 PFL 更具表达力，并实现更高阶的近似精度。

sentences.en: An upper bound on disagreement further reveals two degeneration mechanisms—overly strong collaboration drives consensus (reducing to standard federated learning), while similarity-driven weight updates make the graph nearly reducible and induce self-clustering (collapsing to clustered PFL).
sentences.zh: 一个关于分歧的上界进一步揭示了两种退化机制——过强的协作驱动共识（退化为标准联邦学习），而相似性驱动的权重更新使图几乎可约，并诱导自聚类（坍缩为聚类式 PFL）。

sentences.en: Motivated by these findings, we propose pFedCCG. pFedCCG preserves the expressivity advantage via controlled collaboration geometry (CCG): it builds a static similarity-based collaboration template decoupled from training, optimizes a Markovian collaboration matrix with a prescribed stationary distribution via reversible parameterization and Euclidean projection, and schedules collaboration strength to avoid self-clustering.
sentences.zh: 受这些发现的启发，我们提出 pFedCCG。pFedCCG 通过受控协作几何（CCG）保留表达力优势：它构建一个在训练中分离的、基于相似性的静态协作模板，通过可逆参数化与欧几里得投影优化一个具有规定平稳分布的马尔可夫协作矩阵，并调度协作强度以避免自聚类。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse heterogeneity settings show consistent personalization gains and markedly reduced collapse and self-clustering.
sentences.zh: 在多样异质性设定下的实验显示出一致的个性化收益，以及显著减少的坍缩与自聚类。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/YinHonb/pFedCCG.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YinHonb/pFedCCG 获取。

title_en: Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer
title_zh: 受控动力学吸引子 Transformer

sentences.en: Transformer architectures have dramatically advanced representation learning and inference in deep models through self-attention mechanisms.
sentences.zh: Transformer 架构通过自注意力机制极大地推进了深度模型中的表示学习与推理。

sentences.en: In parallel, associative memory frameworks map representations onto energy landscapes, offering interpretable retrieval mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，联想记忆框架将表示映射到能量景观上，提供了可解释的检索机制。

sentences.en: However, their continuous-time inference dynamics lack the biological plausibility of classical Continuous Attractor Neural Networks.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的连续时间推理动力学缺乏经典连续吸引子神经网络（CANN）的生物学合理性。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose **Controlled Dynamics Attractor Transformer (CDAT)**, which couples a mixture von Mises–Fisher attention energy with a Hopfield refinement energy, while augmenting energy descent with a CANN-inspired excitation–inhibition modulation.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 **受控动力学吸引子 Transformer（CDAT）**，它将混合 von Mises-Fisher 注意力能量与 Hopfield 精炼能量耦合，并用受 CANN 启发的兴奋-抑制调制来增广能量下降。

sentences.en: CDAT instantiates a topology-constrained dynamical system whose couplings encode relational structure among tokens, thereby linking attractor-style dynamics to modern energy-based attention.
sentences.zh: CDAT 实例化了一个拓扑约束的动力系统，其耦合编码词元之间的关系结构，从而将吸引子式动力学与现代基于能量的注意力联系起来。

sentences.en: We further provide a constructive dissipation analysis to formally establish their controlled inference dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供了一个构造性的耗散分析，以正式确立其受控推理动力学。

sentences.en: Benefiting from these robust and structured dynamics, CDAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks in graph anomaly detection and graph classification.
sentences.zh: 得益于这些稳健且结构化的动力学，CDAT 在图异常检测与图分类的多个基准上取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: Controlled LLM Training on Spectral Sphere
title_zh: 谱球面上的可控大语言模型训练

sentences.en: Scaling large models requires optimization strategies that ensure rapid convergence grounded in stability.
sentences.zh: 扩展大型模型需要确保基于稳定性的快速收敛的优化策略。

sentences.en: Maximal Update Parametrization ($\boldsymbol{\mu}$P) provides a theoretical safeguard for width-invariant $\Theta(1)$ activation control, whereas emerging optimizers like Muon are only "half-aligned" with these constraints: they control updates but allow weights to drift.
sentences.zh: 最大更新参数化（$\boldsymbol{\mu}$P）提供了宽度不变的 $\Theta(1)$ 激活控制的理论保障，而 Muon 等新兴优化器与这些约束只是“半对齐的”：它们控制更新，却允许权重漂移。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we introduce the **Spectral Sphere Optimizer (SSO)**, which enforces strict module-wise spectral constraints on both weights and their updates.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们引入 **谱球优化器（SSO）**，它对权重及其更新都强制施加严格的逐模块谱约束。

sentences.en: By deriving the steepest descent direction on the spectral sphere, SSO realizes a fully $\boldsymbol{\mu}$P-aligned optimization process.
sentences.zh: 通过在谱球上推导最速下降方向，SSO 实现了完全 $\boldsymbol{\mu}$P 对齐的优化过程。

sentences.en: To enable large‑scale training, we implement SSO as an efficient parallel algorithm within Megatron.
sentences.zh: 为支持大规模训练，我们在 Megatron 中将 SSO 实现为高效的并行算法。

sentences.en: Through extensive pretraining on diverse architectures, including Dense 1.7B, MoE 8B-A1B, and 200-layer DeepNet models, SSO consistently outperforms AdamW and Muon.
sentences.zh: 通过在不同架构（包括 Dense 1.7B、MoE 8B-A1B 与 200 层 DeepNet 模型）上的广泛预训练，SSO 一致地优于 AdamW 与 Muon。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we observe significant practical stability benefits, including improved MoE router load balancing, suppressed outliers, and strictly bounded activations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们观察到显著的实用稳定性收益，包括改进的 MoE 路由器负载均衡、抑制的离群值以及严格有界的激活。

authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: Controlled SDEs for Long-Horizon Motion Generation under Latent Decision Uncertainty
title_zh: 潜在决策不确定性下用于长程运动生成的受控随机微分方程

sentences.en: Long-horizon motion prediction under external commands is challenged by latent decision uncertainty, where the internal states governing future behavior are unobservable and evolve stochastically over time.
sentences.zh: 外部指令下的长时域运动预测受到潜在决策不确定性的挑战，其中支配未来行为的内部状态不可观测，并随时间随机演化。

sentences.en: This issue is particularly pronounced in biological agents, whose motion trajectories reflect decision-making processes rooted in underlying cognitive states.
sentences.zh: 这一问题在生物智能体中尤为突出，其运动轨迹反映了植根于底层认知状态的决策过程。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose CogSDE, a formulation of a controlled stochastic differential equation (SDE) for modeling instruction-driven latent decision dynamics.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 CogSDE，一种受控随机微分方程（SDE）的表述，用于对指令驱动的潜在决策动力学进行建模。

sentences.en: The drift term in the SDE incorporates a dual-channel control modulation mechanism, enabling external commands to modulate the evolution of latent states.
sentences.zh: SDE 中的漂移项包含一个双通道控制调制机制，使外部指令能够调制潜在状态的演化。

sentences.en: The diffusion term employs a state-dependent operator to model intrinsic uncertainty in latent decision dynamics.
sentences.zh: 扩散项采用一个依赖状态的算子来建模潜在决策动力学中的内在不确定性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we establish dissipativity-based mean-square boundedness for the latent decision dynamics.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为潜在决策动力学确立了基于耗散性的均方有界性。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that CogSDE consistently improves predictive accuracy in long-horizon motion generation.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，CogSDE 在长时域运动生成中一致地改善了预测精度。

sentences.en: Importantly, predicted trajectories remain well aligned with control commands over extended horizons, a property widely recognized as challenging in long-horizon motion prediction.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，预测轨迹在扩展时域上仍与控制指令保持良好的对齐，这一性质在长时域运动预测中被广泛认为具有挑战性。

title_en: Controlling the Risk of Corrupted Contexts for Language Models via Early-Exiting
title_zh: 通过提前退出来控制语言模型受损上下文的风险

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) can be influenced by harmful or irrelevant context, which can significantly harm model performance on downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可能受到有害或无关上下文的影响，这会显著损害模型在下游任务上的性能。

sentences.en: This motivates principled designs in which LLM systems include built-in mechanisms to guard against such "garbage in, garbage out" scenarios.
sentences.zh: 这促使有原则的设计，使 LLM 系统包含内置机制来防范此类“garbage in, garbage out”场景。

sentences.en: We propose a novel approach to limit the degree to which harmful context can degrade model performance.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种新方法，以限制有害上下文能够使模型性能退化的程度。

sentences.en: First, we define a baseline "safe" behavior for the model -- the model's performance given no context at all (zero-shot).
sentences.zh: 首先，我们定义模型的一个基线“安全”行为——即在完全没有上下文（零样本）时的模型性能。

sentences.en: Next, we apply distribution-free risk control (DFRC) to control the extent to which the user-provided context can decay performance below this safe zero-shot baseline.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们应用无分布风险控制（DFRC）来控制用户提供的上下文使性能下降到某个安全零样本基线以下的程度。

sentences.en: We achieve this by leveraging dynamic early exit prediction, ignoring later attention heads that attend the most to the unsafe inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们通过利用动态提前退出预测来实现这一点，忽略那些对不安全输入关注最多的后续注意力头。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose modifications to DFRC that allow it to both control risk for harmful inputs *and* leverage performance and efficiency gains on helpful inputs.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出对 DFRC 的修改，使其既能够控制有害输入的风险，又能够利用有益输入上的性能与效率收益。

sentences.en: We present both theoretical and empirical results across 9 tasks spanning in-context learning and open-ended question answering, showing that our approach can effectively control risk for harmful context and simultaneously achieve substantial computational efficiency gains with helpful context.
sentences.zh: 我们在涵盖上下文学习与开放式问答的 9 项任务上给出了理论与实证结果，表明我们的方法能够有效地控制有害上下文的风险，同时借助有益上下文实现可观的计算效率收益。

title_en: ConTSG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Conditional Time Series Generation
title_zh: ConTSG-Bench：条件时间序列生成的统一基准

sentences.en: Conditional time series generation plays a critical role in addressing data scarcity and enabling causal analysis in real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 条件时间序列生成在应对数据稀缺与实现真实世界应用中的因果分析方面发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: Despite its increasing importance, the field lacks a standardized and systematic benchmarking framework for evaluating generative models across diverse conditions.
sentences.zh: 尽管其重要性日益增加，该领域缺乏一个标准化、系统化的基准框架来跨多样条件评估生成模型。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce the **Con**ditional **T**ime **S**eries **G**eneration **Bench**mark (ConTSG-Bench).
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们引入**条**件**时**间**序**列**生**成**基准**（ConTSG-Bench）。

sentences.en: ConTSG-Bench comprises a suite of large-scale, well-aligned datasets spanning diverse conditioning modalities and levels of semantic abstraction, enabling systematic evaluation of representative generation methods across these dimensions with a comprehensive suite of metrics for generation fidelity and condition adherence.
sentences.zh: ConTSG-Bench 包含一套大规模、良好对齐的数据集，涵盖多样的条件模态与语义抽象层级，能够借助一套用于生成保真度与条件遵从性的综合指标，在这些维度上对代表性生成方法进行系统评估。

sentences.en: Both the quantitative benchmarking and in-depth analyses of conditional generation behaviors have revealed the traits and limitations of the current approaches, highlighting critical challenges and promising research directions, particularly with respect to precise structural controllability and downstream task utility under complex conditions.
sentences.zh: 量化基准测试与对有条件的生成行为的深入分析都揭示了当前方法的特质与局限，凸显了关键挑战与有前景的研究方向，尤其是在精确的结构可控性以及复杂条件下的下游任务效用方面。

title_en: Convergence Analysis of Decentralized Hessian-/Jacobian-Free Algorithm for Nonconvex Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
title_zh: 用于非凸随机双层优化的去中心化免 Hessian/Jacobian 算法收敛分析

sentences.en: Decentralized stochastic bi-level optimization has been actively studied in recent years.
sentences.zh: 去中心化随机双层优化近年来被积极研究。

sentences.en: However, existing studies assume that the lower-level loss function is strongly convex, which limits their applicability to many machine learning models.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有研究假设下层损失函数是强凸的，这限制了它们对许多机器学习模型的适用性。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, in this paper, we propose a novel decentralized stochastic first-order optimization algorithm, which does not require second-order Hessian or Jacobian matrices,  for the setting where the lower-level loss function is nonconvex but satisfies the Polyak–Łojasiewicz (PL) condition.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，在本文中，我们为下层损失函数非凸但满足 Polyak-Łojasiewicz（PL）条件的设定，提出一种新颖的去中心化随机一阶优化算法，它不需要二阶 Hessian 或 Jacobian 矩阵。

sentences.en: Additionally, unlike existing single-agent methods that introduce a regularization term to the lower-level loss function to artificially enforce strong convexity, our algorithm does not require such modification.
sentences.zh: 此外，与现有向损失函数引入正则项以人为强制强凸性的单智能体方法不同，我们的算法不需要这种修改。

sentences.en: Moreover, our algorithm employs a constant single-timescale learning rate for updating variables,  which is different from the time-dependent and two-timescale learning rate schedules used in prior work.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们的算法采用恒定的单时间尺度学习率来更新变量，这与先前工作中使用的时间相关与双时间尺度学习率方案不同。

sentences.en: To establish the convergence rate, we develop a new convergence analysis framework for the pure PL condition, rather than relying on the artificial strong convexity introduced through regularization in existing single-agent methods.
sentences.zh: 为建立收敛率，我们为纯 PL 条件开发了一个新的收敛分析框架，而非依赖现有单智能体方法通过正则化引入的人为强凸性。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm for nonconvex decentralized bi-level optimization that offers theoretical convergence guarantees under mild conditions.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是第一个在温和条件下为非凸去中心化双层优化提供理论收敛保证的算法。

sentences.en: Finally, our extensive experimental results on hyperparameter optimization and model pruning applications validate the efficacy of the proposed algorithm.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在超参数优化与模型剪枝应用上的大量实验结果验证了所提算法的有效性。

title_en: Convergence Analysis of the Lion Optimizer in Centralized and Distributed Settings
title_zh: 集中式与分布式设置下 Lion 优化器的收敛分析

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide a comprehensive convergence analysis for the Lion optimizer.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们为 Lion 优化器提供全面的收敛分析。

sentences.en: First, we establish that the original Lion achieves a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}T^{-1/4})$, where $d$ denotes the problem dimension and $T$ is the iteration number.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们确立原始 Lion 实现 $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}T^{-1/4})$ 的收敛率，其中 d 表示问题维度，T 是迭代次数。

sentences.en: To improve this rate, we propose a variance reduction variant of Lion, which attains an enhanced rate of $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}T^{-1/3})$ with the average smoothness assumption.
sentences.zh: 为改进这一速率，我们提出 Lion 的一个方差缩减变体，在平均光滑性假设下达到改进的 $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}T^{-1/3})$ 速率。

sentences.en: Then, we extend our analysis to distributed settings.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们将分析扩展到分布式设定。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that the distributed Lion optimizer and its variance reduction counterpart achieve linear speedup with respect to the number of nodes $n$, yielding convergence rates of $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}(nT)^{-1/4})$ and $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}(nT)^{-1/3})$, respectively.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，分布式 Lion 优化器及其方差缩减对应版本相对于节点数 n 实现线性加速，分别产生 $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}(nT)^{-1/4})$ 与 $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2}(nT)^{-1/3})$ 的收敛率。

sentences.en: Additionally, we investigate a communication-efficient distributed Lion variant that utilizes sign compression for bidirectional communication.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们研究一种利用符号压缩进行双向通信的通信高效分布式 Lion 变体。

sentences.en: By employing unbiased sign operations, this variant achieves a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O} \left( \max \{ \frac{d^{1/4}}{T^{1/4}}, \frac{d^{1/10}}{n^{1/5}T^{1/5}} \} \right)$, and its variance-reduced counterpart can further improve the rate to $\mathcal{O}\left( \frac{d^{1/4}}{T^{1/4}} \right)$.
sentences.zh: 通过采用无偏符号运算，该变体实现 $\mathcal{O}(\max{ \frac{d^{1/4}}{T^{1/4}}, \frac{d^{1/10}}{n^{1/5}T^{1/5}} })$ 的收敛率，其方差缩减对应版本可以进一步将该速率改进为 $\mathcal{O}(\frac{d^{1/4}}{T^{1/4}})$。

sentences.en: Finally, we conduct numerical experiments to validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们进行数值实验以验证所提方法的有效性。

title_en: Convergence of Steepest Descent and Adam under Non-Uniform Smoothness
title_zh: 非均匀光滑性下最速下降与 Adam 的收敛性

sentences.en: Recent work has analyzed the convergence of first-order methods under non-uniform smoothness assumptions that better model the loss landscape in machine learning tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期工作在更好地建模机器学习任务损失景观的非均匀光滑性假设下，分析了 一阶方法的收敛性。

sentences.en: We generalize this assumption to objectives whose curvature is an affine function of the objective value.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一假设推广到曲率是目标值仿射函数的目标。

sentences.en: This property is satisfied by a broad class of problems, including logistic regression, generalized linear models with a logistic link function, softmax policy gradient in reinforcement learning, and a class of neural networks.
sentences.zh: 这一性质被一大类问题满足，包括逻辑回归、带逻辑连接函数的广义线性模型、强化学习中的 softmax 策略梯度，以及一类神经网络。

sentences.en: Under this assumption and gradient domination conditions, we establish a general convergence rate for the steepest descent method, and deterministic, diagonal variants of RMSProp and Adam.
sentences.zh: 在此假设与梯度支配条件下，我们为最速下降方法以及 RMSProp 与 Adam 的确定性、对角变体建立了通用收敛率。

sentences.en: Our results imply that for logistic regression on separable data and the softmax policy gradient objective, sign GD converges linearly and is provably faster than GD.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，对于可分数据上的逻辑回归与 softmax 策略梯度目标，符号梯度下降（sign GD）线性收敛，并且可证明地比 GD 更快。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that for a class of two-layer neural networks on separable data, RMSProp and Adam can converge at a linear rate with a constant step-size and momentum parameter.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，对于可分数据上的一类两层神经网络，RMSProp 与 Adam 可以以恒定步长与动量参数线性收敛。

sentences.en: Finally, we present a lower bound demonstrating that, under our assumption, RMSProp and Adam are provably faster than AdaGrad, AMSGrad, gradient descent, and heavy-ball momentum.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们给出一个下界，证明在我们的假设下，RMSProp 与 Adam 可证明地比 AdaGrad、AMSGrad、梯度下降与 heavy-ball 动量更快。

title_en: Convergence of Two-Timescale Markovian Stochastic Approximations with Applications in Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 双时间尺度马尔可夫随机逼近的收敛性及其在强化学习中的应用

sentences.en: This work studies the convergence of two-timescale stochastic approximations (SA), a class of iterative algorithms that update two sets of parameters in fast and slow timescales respectively.
sentences.zh: 本工作研究双时间尺度随机近似（SA）的收敛性，这是一类分别以快与慢时间尺度更新两组参数的迭代算法。

sentences.en: Notable examples of two-timescale SA in reinforcement learning (RL) include temporal difference learning with gradient correction (TDC) and actor-critic methods.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）中双时间尺度 SA 的著名例子包括带梯度校正的时序差分学习（TDC）与演员-批评家方法。

sentences.en: Previously, the stability (i.e., boundedness) and convergence of two-timescale SA were only established under i.i.d. noise.
sentences.zh: 先前，双时间尺度 SA 的稳定性（即有界性）与收敛性仅在独立同分布噪声下被建立。

sentences.en: This work instead establishes the stability and convergence of two-timescale SA under Markovian noise, a setup that is more realistic in RL.
sentences.zh: 本工作则在此设置下确立马尔可夫噪声下双时间尺度 SA 的稳定性与收敛性，这一设定在 RL 中更为现实。

sentences.en: Notably, we do not need to use any projection operator and the noise does not need to live in a compact space.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们不需要使用任何投影算子，噪声也不需要在紧空间中。

sentences.en: Our key technical novelty is to control the fast timescale parameter with the running max of the slow timescale parameter, instead of with the current slow timescale parameter, as most prior works do.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键技术新颖之处在于，用慢时间尺度参数的运行最大值（而非像大多数先前工作那样用当前慢时间尺度参数）来控制快时间尺度参数。

sentences.en: As a key application, we establish the first almost sure convergence of TDC with eligibility traces under off-policy learning with linear function approximation.
sentences.zh: 作为一个关键应用，我们确立了带资格迹的 TDC 在带线性函数逼近的离策略学习下的第一个几乎必然收敛性。

title_zh: AdamW 风格 Shampoo 的收敛速率分析：统一单侧与双侧预条件
