title_en: Convergence Rate of the Last Iterate of Stochastic Proximal Algorithms
title_zh: 随机近端算法最后迭代点的收敛速率

sentences.en: We analyze two classical algorithms for solving additively composite convex optimization problems where the objective is the sum of a smooth term and a nonsmooth regularizer.
sentences.zh: 我们分析两种用于求解加性复合凸优化问题（其中目标是一个光滑项与一个非光滑正则化器之和）的经典算法。

sentences.en: The first algorithm is the proximal stochastic gradient method for a single regularizer; the second is the randomized incremental proximal method, which uses the proximal operator of a randomly selected function when the regularizer is given as the sum of many nonsmooth functions.
sentences.zh: 第一种算法是用于单一正则化器的近端随机梯度方法；第二种是随机增量近端方法，当正则化器由许多非光滑函数之和给出时，它使用随机选择函数的近端算子。

sentences.en: We focus on relaxing the bounded variance assumption that is common, yet stringent, for getting last iterate convergence rates.
sentences.zh: 我们专注于放宽常见的、但对于获得最后一次迭代收敛率而言严苛的方差有界假设。

sentences.en: We prove the $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate of convergence for the last iterate of both algorithms under componentwise convexity and smoothness, which is optimal up to log terms.
sentences.zh: 在逐分量凸性与光滑性下，我们证明两种算法最后一次迭代的 O~(1/sqrt(T)) 收敛率，这在对数项以内是最优的。

sentences.en: Our results apply directly to graph-guided regularizers that arise in multi-task and federated learning, where the regularizer decomposes as a sum over edges of a collaboration graph.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果直接适用于多任务与联邦学习中出现的图引导正则化器，其中正则化器分解为协作图边上的和。

title_en: Convergent World Representations and Divergent Tasks
title_zh: 趋同的世界表征与分化的任务

sentences.en: While neural representations are central to modern deep learning, the conditions governing their geometry and their roles in downstream adaptability remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 虽然神经表示是现代深度学习的核心，但支配其几何形态的条件及其在下游适应性中的作用仍未被充分理解。

sentences.en: We develop a framework clearly separating the underlying world, the data generation process and the resulting model representations to study these questions in a controlled setup: 5,075 city coordinates define the world and 7 geometric tasks generate the training data for autoregressive Transformer training.
sentences.zh: 我们开发一个清晰分离底层世界、数据生成过程与所产生模型表示的框架，在一个受控设定中研究这些问题：5,075 个城市坐标定义世界，7 个几何任务为自回归 Transformer 训练生成训练数据。

sentences.en: We find that different tasks give rise to qualitatively and quantitatively distinct world representation geometries.
sentences.zh: 我们发现不同的任务产生性质与数量上都不同的世界表示几何。

sentences.en: However, multi-task training drives convergence of world representations: models trained on non-overlapping tasks develop aligned geometric representations, providing controlled evidence for the Multitask Scaling Hypothesis of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 然而，多任务训练驱动世界表示的收敛：在非重叠任务上训练的模型发展出对齐的几何表示，为柏拉图式表示假说中的多任务扩展假说提供了受控证据。

sentences.en: To study adaptation, we pretrain models on all tasks and all cities, then test whether new entities can be consistently integrated into the representation space via fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 为研究适应性，我们在所有任务与所有城市上预训练模型，然后测试新实体能否通过微调被一致地整合进表示空间。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, we find that despite multi-task pretraining, some tasks, which we call divergent, actively harm the representational integration of new entities.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，我们发现尽管进行了多任务预训练，一些我们称之为发散的（divergent）任务，会积极地损害新实体的表示整合。

sentences.en: Our results show that training on multiple relational tasks reliably produces convergent world representations, but some lurking divergent tasks can catastrophically harm new entity integration via fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，在多个关系任务上训练能可靠地产生收敛的世界表示，但一些潜伏的发散任务可以通过微调灾难性地损害新实体的整合。

title_en: Conversation for Non-verifiable Learning: Self-Evolving Large Language Models through Meta-Evaluation
title_zh: 通过对话开展不可验证学习：利用元评估实现大语言模型自进化

sentences.en: Training large language models (LLMs) for non-verifiable tasks—such as creative writing, dialogue, and ethical reasoning—remains challenging due to the absence of ground-truth labels.
sentences.zh: 为不可验证任务（例如创造性写作、对话与伦理推理）训练大语言模型（LLM）由于缺乏真实标签仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: While LLM-as-Judge approaches offer a scalable alternative to human feedback, they face a fundamental limitation: performance is constrained by the evaluator's own quality.
sentences.zh: 虽然 LLM 作为评判者的方法为人类反馈提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但它们面临一个根本性的局限：性能受限于评估者自身的质量。

sentences.en: If the judge cannot recognize good solutions, it cannot provide useful training signals, and evaluation biases (e.g., favoring verbosity over quality) remain unaddressed.
sentences.zh: 如果评判者无法识别好的解决方案，它就无法提供有用的训练信号，并且评估偏差（例如偏爱冗长而非质量）仍未得到解决。

sentences.en: This motivates meta-evaluation—the ability to evaluate and improve the evaluator itself.
sentences.zh: 这促使了元评估——评估并改进评估者本身的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce CoNL, a framework that unifies generation, evaluation, and meta-evaluation through multi-agent self-play.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 CoNL，一个通过多智能体自博弈统一生成、评估与元评估的框架。

sentences.en: Our key insight: critique quality can be measured by whether it helps others improve their solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是：批评质量可以通过它是否帮助他人改进其解决方案来衡量。

sentences.en: In CoNL, multiple agents sharing the same policy engage in structured conversations to propose, critique, and revise solutions.
sentences.zh: 在 CoNL 中，共享同一策略的多个智能体进行结构化对话，以提出、批评与修订解决方案。

sentences.en: Critiques that enable other agents' solution improvements earn a diagnostic reward, creating explicit supervision for meta-evaluation and enabling joint optimization of generation and judging capabilities through self-play, without external judges or ground truth.
sentences.zh: 能够促使其他智能体解决方案改进的批评会获得诊断奖励，为元评估创造显式监督，并通过自博弈实现生成与评判能力的联合优化，而无需外部评判者或真实标签。

sentences.en: Experiments on various benchmarks show that CoNL achieves consistent improvements over self-rewarding baselines while maintaining stable training.
sentences.zh: 在各种基准上的实验表明，CoNL 在保持稳定训练的同时，相较于自我奖励基线实现了一致的改进。

title_en: Convex Basins in Single-Index Model Loss Landscapes: Applications to Robust Recovery under Strong Adversarial Corruption
title_zh: 单指标模型损失景观中的凸吸引域：应用于强对抗污染下的鲁棒恢复

sentences.en: In this paper, we tackle a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, namely, learning Single Index Models (SIMs) robustly in the presence of heavy-tailed noise and an adversary that can corrupt a constant fraction of both covariates and responses.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们攻克高维统计中的一个根本性问题，即存在重尾噪声，以及一个能够腐蚀固定比例协变量与响应的对手时，稳健地学习单指标模型（SIM）。

sentences.en: Prior research on efficient robust recovery only focuses on  monotonic link functions or only limit themselves to Phase Retrieval.
sentences.zh: 先前关于高效稳健恢复的研究只聚焦于单调链接函数，或只局限于相位恢复（Phase Retrieval）。

sentences.en: Provable efficient robust recovery guarantees for generic nonlinear link functions have remained elusive.
sentences.zh: 对一般非线性链接函数的可证明高效稳健恢复保证仍然难以实现。

sentences.en: In this paper, we obtain the first near-linear time, optimal-sample-complexity robust recovery algorithm for a wide class of nonlinear non-monotonic link functions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们为一大类非线性非单调链接函数获得了第一个近线性时间、最优样本复杂度的稳健恢复算法。

sentences.en: Critical to our result is an improved understanding of the squared-loss landscape: we identify a sufficient condition under which a broad class of non linear link functions admit a dimension-independent constant-radius convex basin around the ground truth, establishing statistical identifiability beyond previously known cases.
sentences.zh: 对我们的结果起关键作用的是对平方损失景观的改进理解：我们识别出一个充分条件，在该条件下，一大类非线性链接函数在真实值周围具有与维度无关的常数半径凸盆地，从而确立了超越先前已知情形的统计可辨识性。

sentences.en: We also leverage second-order Stein's identities to identify a structural condition, that we term Expected Squared Convexity (ESC), that acts as a sufficient condition for spectral initialization techniques to obtain an estimator within the convex basin with error $O(\epsilon^{1/4})$, even under heavy-tailed noise and strong adversarial contamination.
sentences.zh: 我们还利用二阶 Stein 恒等式识别出一个结构条件，我们称之为期望平方凸性（ESC），它作为谱初始化技术获得凸盆地内估计器（误差为 O(eps^(1/4))）的充分条件，即使在重尾噪声与强对抗污染下也是如此。

sentences.en: This robust initialization technique can be combined with a robust gradient descent phase to break the spectral error barrier, achieving an improved estimation error of $O(\sigma\sqrt{\epsilon})$.
sentences.zh: 这一稳健的初始化技术可以与稳健梯度下降阶段相结合，以突破谱误差屏障，实现改进的 O(sigma sqrt(eps)) 估计误差。

sentences.en: Our non-convex optimization framework gives the first efficient sample and time complexity robust recovery results for activation functions such as GeLU and Swish that act as building blocks of modern deep-learning architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们的非凸优化框架为诸如 GeLU 与 Swish 等作为现代深度学习架构构建块的激活函数，提供了第一个高效的样本与时间复杂度的稳健恢复结果。

authors.name: jatin batra
authors.institution: Tata institute of fundamental research, Mumbai

title_en: Convex Dataset Valuation for Post-Training
title_zh: 用于后训练的凸数据集估值

sentences.en: Improving LLM performance on downstream tasks sometimes requires leveraging auxiliary datasets during post-training.
sentences.zh: 在下游任务上提升 LLM 性能，有时需要在后训练期间利用辅助数据集。

sentences.en: In practice, however, developers face constraints on compute, labeling, and licensing costs that preclude using all available data, necessitating principled dataset-level selection.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，开发者面临计算、标注与许可成本的约束，这些约束使他们无法使用所有可用数据，从而需要基于原则的数据集级选择。

sentences.en: These constraints are increasingly shaped by dataset marketplaces, where data acquisition is governed by budgets and negotiation.
sentences.zh: 这些约束日益受到数据集市场的影响，其中数据采购受预算与谈判支配。

sentences.en: We study dataset valuation as a subset selection problem during LLM post-training.
sentences.zh: 我们将 LLM 后训练期间的数据集估值研究为一个子集选择问题。

sentences.en: Our goal is to identify and weight auxiliary datasets so as to maximize target task performance given constrained budgets.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是识别辅助数据集并为其赋权，从而在预算受限下最大化目标任务性能。

sentences.en: We first show that commonly used gradient alignment scores provide a reasonable yet incomplete valuation signal, as they ignore redundancy among datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们首先表明，常用的梯度对齐分数提供了合理但不完整的估值信号，因为它们忽略了数据集之间的冗余。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a scalable convex dataset-level valuation method based on kernel mean matching (KMM) in gradient space, which jointly accounts for alignment with the target task and redundancy across auxiliary datasets.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出一种可扩展的凸数据集级估值方法，它基于梯度空间中的核均值匹配（KMM），联合考虑与目标任务的对齐以及跨辅助数据集的冗余。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments across diverse post-training settings and tasks, we show that our approach consistently outperforms existing valuation baselines, achieving stronger performance with low computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 通过跨多样后训练设定与任务的大量实验，我们表明我们的方法一致地优于现有估值基线，以较低的计算开销取得更强的性能。

sentences.en: Our results position dataset valuation as a practical decision tool for post-training data selection in market-constrained large language model settings.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果将数据集估值定位为市场受限的大语言模型设定中选择后训练数据的实用决策工具。

title_en: Convex Distance Operator Transport: A Convex and Geometry-Preserving Formulation
title_zh: 凸距离算子输运：一种凸且保持几何结构的表述

sentences.en: We introduce Convex Distance Operator Transport (CDOT), the first convex optimal transport framework that aligns distributions across heterogeneous domains by jointly preserving feature correspondence and intrinsic geometric structure.
sentences.zh: 我们引入凸距离算子输运（CDOT），第一个通过联合保留特征对应与内在几何结构来对齐跨异构域分布的凸最优输运框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, CDOT employs an operator-based regularization that aligns aggregated distance structures by introducing distance and conditional expectation operators.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，CDOT 采用一种基于算子的正则化，通过引入距离与条件期望算子来对齐聚合的距离结构。

sentences.en: Consequently, the proposed regularization improves the robustness to local geometric variations.
sentences.zh: 因此，所提出的正则化提升了对局部几何变化的稳健性。

sentences.en: We further prove that the resulting CDOT discrepancy is a valid pseudometric on the space of attributed compact metric-measure spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，由此产生的 CDOT 差异是带属性紧度量-测度空间上的一个有效伪度量。

sentences.en: In addition, we characterize the relationship between CDOT and Gromov--Wasserstien (GW) through a new notion of dispersion gap, formally elucidating the geometric source of non-convexity in GW compared to the convexity of CDOT.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过一个新的离散度间隙（dispersion gap）概念刻画了 CDOT 与 Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）之间的关系，从形式上阐明了与 CDOT 凸性相比，GW 非凸性的几何来源。

sentences.en: In the finite-sample regime, we derive a non-asymptotic risk bound decomposed into optimization and statistical errors, establishing risk consistency under a globally convergent Frank--Wolfe algorithm.
sentences.zh: 在有限样本情境下，我们推导了一个分解为优化误差与统计误差的非渐近风险界，在全局收敛的 Frank-Wolfe 算法下确立了风险一致性。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic point clouds, brain connectomes, and graph classification benchmarks demonstrate better performance over existing methods, with stable and reliable behavior in practice.
sentences.zh: 在合成点云、脑连接组与图分类基准上的实验表明，与现有方法相比性能更优，且在实践行为上稳定可靠。

authors.name: Won Hwa Kim
authors.institution: Pohang University of Science and Technology

title_en: Convex Low-resource Accent-Robust Language Detection in Speech Recognition
title_zh: 语音识别中低资源、口音鲁棒的凸语言检测

sentences.en: Globalization and multiculturalism continue to produce increasingly diverse speech varieties.
sentences.zh: 全球化与多元文化不断产生越来越多样化的语音变体。

sentences.en: Yet current spoken dialogue systems frequently fail on under-represented dialects and accents, often misidentifying the input language and causing cascading failures in downstream dialogue tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的对话系统常常在代表性不足的方言与口音上失败，常常错误识别输入语言，导致下游对话任务中的级联失效。

sentences.en: Addressing this dialectal variance under low-resource constraints remains an open challenge, as standard fine-tuning is computationally expensive and prone to overfitting on high-dimensional speech data.
sentences.zh: 在低资源约束下应对这种方言差异仍然是一个开放挑战，因为标准微调计算昂贵，并且易于在高维语音数据上过拟合。

sentences.en: We propose Convex Language Detection (CLD), a novel framework that integrates theoretically grounded convex optimization techniques into the spoken dialogue systems pipeline.
sentences.zh: 我们提出凸语言检测（CLD），一个将理论扎实的凸优化技术整合进对话系统流水线的新框架。

sentences.en: Our method is efficiently implemented via multi-GPU Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) in JAX, thus providing global optimality guarantees and fast training in polynomial time.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过 JAX 中的多 GPU 交替方向乘子法（ADMM）高效实现，从而在多项式时间内提供全局最优性保证与快速训练。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that our convex objective induces certified margin stability and provide guarantees against feature perturbations.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明我们的凸目标诱导经认证的边际稳定性，并提供针对特征扰动的保证。

sentences.en: Empirically, we demonstrate sample efficiency and robustness to input dialectical variation, achieving 97–98\% accuracy in challenging low-resource regimes.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们展示了样本效率与对输入方言变化的稳健性，在具有挑战性的低资源情境下达到 97–98\% 的精度。

sentences.en: Our open-source package is available at https://pypi.org/project/jaxcld/.
sentences.zh: 我们的开源软件包可在 https://pypi.org/project/jaxcld/ 获取。

title_en: Convex Optimization for Alignment and Preference Learning on a Single GPU
title_zh: 单张 GPU 上用于对齐与偏好学习的凸优化

sentences.en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to align with human preferences has driven the success of systems such as Gemini and ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: 微调大语言模型（LLM）以与人类偏好对齐，推动了 Gemini 与 ChatGPT 等系统的成功。

sentences.en: However, approaches like Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) remain computationally expensive and complex.
sentences.zh: 然而，诸如基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）之类的方法仍然计算昂贵且复杂。

sentences.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) offers a simpler alternative but has limitations such as inconsistent ranking accuracy, high dependence on GPU resources, and expensive hyperparameter tuning.
sentences.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）提供了更简单的替代方案，但具有诸如排名精度不一致、对 GPU 资源高度依赖以及超参数调优昂贵等局限。

sentences.en: We propose the Convex Optimization for Alignment and Preference Learning Algorithm (COALA): a novel lightweight strategy with strong theoretical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们提出对齐与偏好学习凸优化算法（COALA）：一种具有强理论保证的新颖轻量策略。

sentences.en: By leveraging the convex optimization reformulation of neural networks, COALA eliminates the need for a reference model and obtains significant reduction in both training time and VRAM consumption, thus enabling efficient training on a single GPU.
sentences.zh: 通过利用神经网络的凸优化重述，COALA 消除了对参考模型的需求，并在训练时间与显存消耗上都获得显著降低，从而能够在单 GPU 上高效训练。

sentences.en: Experiments across four datasets—including a 26621-sample synthetic Educational Feedback dataset—and six models (including Llama-3.1-8B) demonstrate COALA's competitive performance and efficiency while utilizing as little as ${\sim}17.6\%$ of DPO's total TFLOPs.
sentences.zh: 跨四个数据集（包括一个 26621 样本的合成教育反馈数据集）与六个模型（包括 Llama-3.1-8B）的实验表明，COALA 的性能与效率具有竞争力，而利用的算力仅为 DPO 总 TFLOPs 的约 17.6\%。

sentences.en: COALA exhibits stable, monotonically increasing rewards and reaches peak margins in significantly shorter time in comparison to traditional methods such as DPO and ORPO.
sentences.zh: 与 DPO 与 ORPO 等传统方法相比，COALA 表现出稳定、单调增加的奖励，并在显著更短的时间内达到峰值边际。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time convex optimization has been effectively applied to preference fine-tuning of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是凸优化首次被有效地应用于 LLM 的偏好微调。

title_en: ConvexBench: Can LLMs Recognize Convex Functions?
title_zh: ConvexBench：大语言模型能否识别凸函数？

sentences.en: Convexity recognition plays a central role in many optimization, control, and learning problems.
sentences.zh: 凸性识别在许多优化、控制与学习问题中发挥着核心作用。

sentences.en: However, the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify this property in symbolic expressions remains unexamined.
sentences.zh: 然而，大语言模型（LLM）识别符号表达式中这一性质的能力尚未被考察。

sentences.en: We introduce ConvexBench, a scalable and mechanically verifiable benchmark for testing whether LLMs can determine the convexity of a symbolic objective under deep functional composition.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ConvexBench，一个可扩展且可机械化验证的基准，用于测试 LLM 能否在深层函数组合下确定符号目标的凸性。

sentences.en: Experiments on frontier LLMs reveal a sharp \textit{compositional reasoning gap}: performance degrades rapidly with increasing depth,  dropping from an F1-score of $1.0$ at depth $2$ to approximately $0.2$ at depth $100$.
sentences.zh: 对前沿 LLM 的实验揭示了一个尖锐的\textit{compositional reasoning gap}：性能随深度增加而迅速下降，从深度 $2$ 处的 F1 分数 $1.0$ 下降到深度 $100$ 处约 0.2。

sentences.en: Inspection of models' reasoning traces indicates two failure modes: \textit{parsing failure} and \textit{lazy reasoning}.
sentences.zh: 对模型推理轨迹的检查指出了两种失败模式：\textit{parsing failure}与\textit{lazy reasoning}。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose an agentic divide-and-conquer framework that (i) offloads parsing to an external tool to construct an abstract syntax tree (AST) and (ii) enforces recursive reasoning over each intermediate sub-expression with focused context.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出一个智能体式的分而治之框架，它（i）将解析卸载到外部工具以构建抽象语法树（AST），并且（ii）对每个中间子表达式强制进行带聚焦上下文的递归推理。

sentences.en: This framework reliably mitigates deep-composition failures, achieving substantial performance improvement at large depths (e.g., F1-Score $= 1.0$ at depth $100$).
sentences.zh: 该框架可靠地缓解了深度组合失败，在大深度下实现了显著的性能改进（例如深度 $100$ 处 F1 分数 $= 1.0$）。

title_en: Convolutional Learnable-Group Weightless Neural Network
title_zh: 卷积式可学习分组无权重神经网络

sentences.en: Weightless Neural Networks (WNNs) based on interconnected Lookup Tables (LUTs) have attracted attention for inference in extremely compact models, but achieving competitive accuracy under such tight resource budgets remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 基于互连查找表（LUT）的无权重神经网络（WNN）因能在极紧凑模型中进行推理而备受关注，但在如此紧张的资源预算下实现有竞争力的精度仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we introduce the Convolutional Learnable-Group Weightless Neural Network (CLGN).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们引入卷积可学习分组无权重神经网络（CLGN）。

sentences.en: CLGN constructs convolutional layers using LUTs and incorporates a learnable GroupSum connection, thereby enhancing the accuracy of WNNs while maintaining low implementation resource consumption.
sentences.zh: CLGN 使用 LUT 构建卷积层，并纳入一个可学习的 GroupSum 连接，从而在保持低实现资源消耗的同时提升 WNN 的精度。

sentences.en: Moreover, we propose a hierarchical training strategy to improve the training efficiency.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一种层次化训练策略来提升训练效率。

sentences.en: We evaluate CLGN in two edge computing scenarios: (1) FPGA, where we evaluate accuracy, latency, throughput, power consumption, LUTs usage, and parameter size; and (2) Microprocessor, where we evaluate latency and memory usage.
sentences.zh: 我们在两种边缘计算场景中评估 CLGN：（1）FPGA，其中我们评估精度、延迟、吞吐量、功耗、LUT 用量与参数大小；（2）微处理器，其中我们评估延迟与内存占用。

sentences.en: Compared with the state-of-the-art solutions, the proposed CLGN achieves superior accuracy while maintaining lower implementation resource consumption.
sentences.zh: 与最先进的解决方案相比，所提出的 CLGN 在保持更低实现资源消耗的同时取得了更优的精度。

title_en: Cooperative Variance Estimation and Bayesian Neural Networks for Disentangling Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainties
title_zh: 通过协同方差估计与贝叶斯神经网络解耦偶然不确定性和认知不确定性

sentences.en: Real-world data contains aleatoric uncertainty - irreducible noise arising from imperfect measurements or from incomplete knowledge about the data generation process.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的数据包含随意不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）——由不完美的测量或对数据生成过程的不完整认知所产生的不可约减噪声。

sentences.en: Mean-variance estimation networks can learn this type of uncertainty but require ad-hoc regularization strategies to avoid overfitting and are unable to predict epistemic uncertainty (model uncertainty).
sentences.zh: 均值-方差估计网络可以学习这类不确定性，但需要即兴的正则化策略以避免过拟合，并且无法预测认知不确定性（模型不确定性）。

sentences.en: Conversely, Bayesian neural networks predict epistemic uncertainty but are notoriously difficult to train due to the approximate nature of Bayesian inference.
sentences.zh: 相反，贝叶斯神经网络预测认知不确定性，但由于贝叶斯推断的近似本质，它出了名的难以训练。

sentences.en: We propose to cooperatively train a variance estimation network with a Bayesian neural network and empirically demonstrate that the resulting model disentangles aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties while improving the mean estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们提议将方差估计网络与贝叶斯神经网络协作训练，并在经验上证明，由此产生的模型在改进均值估计的同时解耦了随意不确定性与认知不确定性。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of this method across a diverse range of datasets, including a time-dependent heteroscedastic regression dataset we created where the aleatoric uncertainty is known.
sentences.zh: 我们在一系列多样数据集上证明了该方法的有效性与可扩展性，包括我们创建的、随意不确定性已知的时间依赖异方差回归数据集。

sentences.en: The proposed method is straightforward to implement, robust, and adaptable to various model architectures.
sentences.zh: 所提方法易于实现、稳健，并且可适应各种模型架构。

title_en: CoopEval: Benchmarking Cooperation-Sustaining Mechanisms and LLM Agents in Social Dilemmas
title_zh: CoopEval：评测社会困境中的合作维持机制与大语言模型智能体

sentences.en: It is increasingly important that LLM agents interact effectively and safely with other goal-pursuing agents, yet, recent works report the opposite trend: LLMs with stronger reasoning capabilities behave _less_ cooperatively in mixed-motive games such as the prisoner's dilemma and public goods settings.
sentences.zh: LLM 智能体与其他追求目标的智能体进行有效且安全的交互日益重要，然而近期工作却报道了相反的趋势：推理能力更强的 LLM 在囚徒困境与公共品等混合动机博弈中表现得_更不_合作。

sentences.en: Indeed, our experiments show that recent models---with or without reasoning enabled---consistently defect in single-shot social dilemmas.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们的实验表明，近期模型——无论是否启用推理——在一次性社会困境中都一致地背叛。

sentences.en: To tackle this safety concern, we present the first comparative study of game-theoretic mechanisms designed to enable cooperative outcomes between rational agents _in equilibrium_.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一安全问题，我们提出了第一个对旨在_在均衡中_实现理性智能体之间合作结果的博弈论机制的比较性研究。

sentences.en: Across four social dilemmas testing distinct components of robust cooperation, we evaluate four families of mechanisms: (1) repeating the game for many rounds, (2) reputation systems, (3) third-party mediators to delegate decision making to, and (4) contract agreements for outcome-conditional payments between players.
sentences.zh: 在四个测试稳健合作不同组成部分的社会困境中，我们评估了四族机制：（1）将博弈重复多个回合，（2）声誉系统，（3）第三方调解人以委托决策，以及（4）用于玩家之间结果条件支付的合同协议。

sentences.en: Among our findings, we establish that contracting and mediation are most effective in achieving cooperative outcomes between capable LLM models, and that repetition-induced cooperation deteriorates drastically when co-players vary.
sentences.zh: 在我们的发现中，我们确立契约与调解在功能强大的 LLM 模型之间实现合作结果方面最为有效，并且当共同参与者在变化时，由重复诱导的合作会急剧恶化。

sentences.en: Moreover, we demonstrate that the mechanisms become _more effective_ under evolutionary pressures to maximize individual payoffs.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明，在最大化个体收益的演化压力下，这些机制变得_更有效_。

title_en: Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative Mode Discovery Under Hidden Correlations
title_zh: 隐藏相关性下结合迭代模式发现的协同解耦

sentences.en: Disentangled representation learning is a powerful paradigm for robust attribute prediction.
sentences.zh: 解耦表示学习是稳健属性预测的强大范式。

sentences.en: While recent methods address attribute correlations, hidden correlations remain underexplored, where data under the value of a certain attribute exhibit underlying modes correlated with other attributes.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期方法解决了属性相关性，但隐藏相关性仍未得到充分探索，其中某个属性取值下的数据表现出与其他属性相关的底层模式。

sentences.en: To preserve mode information and achieve disentanglement, we jointly discover modes and enforce mode-based conditional independence.
sentences.zh: 为保留模式信息并实现解耦，我们联合发现模式并对模式施加基于模式的独立性条件。

sentences.en: Yet, the interdependency between these two modules may lead to error amplification under naive iterations.
sentences.zh: 然而，这两个模块之间的相互依赖在朴素迭代下可能导致误差放大。

sentences.en: We propose Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative mode Discovery (CoDID), an end-to-end framework featuring a dynamic architecture that adapts to evolving number of modes, and a coordination mechanism that mitigates error amplification via meta-optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出带迭代模式发现的协调解耦（CoDID），一个端到端框架，具有适应演化模式数量的动态架构，以及通过元优化缓解误差放大的协调机制。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance on diverse tasks.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明其在多样任务上取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: CooT: Learning to Coordinate In-Context with Coordination Transformers
title_zh: CooT：利用协调 Transformer 学习上下文内协调

sentences.en: Effective coordination among unfamiliar partners remains a major challenge in multi-agent systems.
sentences.zh: 在不熟悉伙伴之间实现有效协调，仍然是对多智能体系统的重大挑战。

sentences.en: Existing approaches, such as population-based methods, improve robustness through diversity but often lack mechanisms for efficient adaptation beyond the training distribution.
sentences.zh: 诸如基于群体的方法等现有方法通过多样性提升稳健性，但常常缺乏在训练分布之外进行高效适应的机制。

sentences.en: Fine-tuning is also impractical for few-shot learning because it requires a large number of interactions for meaningful improvement.
sentences.zh: 微调对少样本学习也不切实际，因为它需要大量交互才能获得有意义的改进。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose Coordination Transformers (CooT), a framework that leverages in-context learning (ICL) for real-time partner adaptation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出协调 Transformer（CooT），一个利用上下文学习（ICL）进行实时伙伴适应的框架。

sentences.en: Unlike prior ICL approaches that focus on task generalization, CooT is designed to generalize across diverse partner behaviors.
sentences.zh: 与聚焦任务泛化的先前 ICL 方法不同，CooT 被设计用于跨多样伙伴行为泛化。

sentences.en: Trained on trajectories from behavior-preferring agents, it learns to align actions with partner intentions purely through observation.
sentences.zh: 在偏好行为的智能体的轨迹上训练，它学会仅通过观察就使动作与伙伴意图对齐。

sentences.en: We evaluate CooT on two challenging multi-agent benchmarks: Overcooked and Google Research Football.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个具有挑战性的多智能体基准上评估了 CooT：Overcooked 与 Google Research Football。

sentences.en: Results show that CooT consistently outperforms population-based methods, gradient-based fine-tuning, and Meta-RL baselines, achieving stable and rapid adaptation without parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，CooT 一致地优于基于群体的方法、基于梯度的微调与元 RL 基线，在无需参数更新的情况下实现稳定而快速的适应。

sentences.en: Human evaluations also identify CooT as a preferred collaborator, and our ablations confirm its ability to adapt quickly to new partners and remain stable under sudden partner changes, making it reliable for real-world human-AI collaboration.
sentences.zh: 人类评估也将 CooT 视为首选协作者，我们的消融证实它能够快速适应新伙伴，并在伙伴突变下保持稳定，使其对现实世界的人机协作而言可靠。

title_en: CoPE: A Framework for Optimizing Coordination between Planning and Execution in LLM-based Agents
title_zh: CoPE：优化基于大语言模型的智能体中规划与执行协调的框架

sentences.en: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) as autonomous agents on domain-specific data has emerged as a promising paradigm for tackling interactive, real-world tasks.
sentences.zh: 在领域特定数据上将大语言模型（LLM）微调为自主智能体，已成为攻克交互式现实任务的有前景范式。

sentences.en: However, existing studies have overlooked the critical coordination between long-term planning and multi-step execution in optimizing agent capabilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有研究忽视了在优化智能体能力时，长期规划与多步执行之间关键的协调。

sentences.en: This oversight leads to the propagation of impractical plans and plan-deviated trajectories within the optimization process, resulting in suboptimal task performance and hindering the further development of LLM-based agents in long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 这一忽视导致优化过程中不切实际的计划与偏离计划的轨迹得以传播，造成任务性能次优，并阻碍了基于 LLM 智能体在长时序任务上的进一步发展。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose $\textbf{CoPE}$, a novel framework that explicitly integrates planning–execution coordination into LLM-based agent optimization.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 \textbf{CoPE}，一个将规划-执行协调显式整合进基于 LLM 智能体优化的新框架。

sentences.en: CoPE employs Self-Refining MCTS to generate task plans and multiple execution trajectories through environment interactions.
sentences.zh: CoPE 采用自精炼 MCTS 通过环境交互生成任务计划与多条执行轨迹。

sentences.en: By quantifying the coordination between planning and execution, CoPE assigns higher optimization weights to well-coordinated samples, enabling LLM-based agents to learn better planning and execution policies.
sentences.zh: 通过量化规划与执行之间的协调，CoPE 为协调良好的样本分配更高的优化权重，使基于 LLM 的智能体能够学习更好的规划与执行策略。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoPE substantially improves agent coordination, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines on benchmarks comprising two long-horizon multi-step tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CoPE 大幅提升了智能体协调能力，在两个长时序多步任务组成的基准上优于最先进的基线。

sentences.en: Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Octobrist/CoPE.
sentences.zh: 代码与数据可在 https://github.com/Octobrist/CoPE 获取。

title_en: CoPE: Continual Probe-guided Expansion for Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: CoPE：大型视觉语言模型的持续探针引导扩展

sentences.en: Mixture of Experts architectures have recently advanced the scalability and adaptability of Large Language Models for continual multimodal learning.
sentences.zh: 混合专家架构近来推进了大语言模型在持续多模态学习中的可扩展性与自适性。

sentences.en: However, extending these models to accommodate sequential tasks remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，扩展这些模型以适应顺序任务仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: As new tasks arrive, naive model expansion leads to rapid parameter growth, while modifying shared routing components often causes catastrophic forgetting, undermining previously learned knowledge.
sentences.zh: 随着新任务的到来，朴素的模型扩展会导致参数快速增长，而修改共享的路由组件常常造成灾难性遗忘，破坏先前学到的知识。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose CoPE, a continual learning framework for LLMs that requires no replay data of previous tasks and ensures both parameter efficiency and robust knowledge retention.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 CoPE，一个面向 LLM 的持续学习框架，它不需要先验任务的重放数据，并同时确保参数效率与稳健性。

sentences.en: Our approach introduces the Probe-Guided Knowledge Extension mechanism, which uses probe experts to dynamically determine when and where new experts should be added, enabling adaptive and minimal parameter expansion tailored to task complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法引入探针引导知识扩展机制，它使用探针专家动态地确定何时何地应添加新专家，从而实现针对任务复杂性量身定制的自适应、最小参数扩展。

sentences.en: To support inference without task labels, we further incorporate a Probabilistic Task Locator that dynamically matches inputs to the correct task-specific components.
sentences.zh: 为支持在没有任务标签情况下的推理，我们进一步纳入一个概率任务定位器，它将输入动态匹配到正确的任务特定组件。

sentences.en: To handle the practical issue that task labels are unknown during inference, we leverage a VAE-based reconstruction strategy to identify the most suitable router by matching input distributions, allowing automatic and accurate expert allocation.
sentences.zh: 为处理推理期间任务标签未知这一实际问题，我们利用一种基于 VAE 的重构策略，通过匹配输入分布来识别最合适的路由器，从而实现自动且精确的专家分配。

sentences.en: This design mitigates routing conflicts and catastrophic forgetting, enabling robust continual learning without explicit task labels.
sentences.zh: 这一设计缓解了路由冲突与灾难性遗忘，使无显式任务标签的稳健持续学习成为可能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the CoIN benchmark, covering eight diverse VQA tasks, demonstrate that CoPE delivers strong continual learning performance with a compact model size, significantly reducing forgetting and parameter overhead compared to prior methods.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖八个多样 VQA 任务的 CoIN 基准上的大量实验表明，CoPE 以紧凑的模型规模交付了强劲的持续学习性能，与先前方法相比显著减少了遗忘与参数开销。

sentences.en: These results showcase the effectiveness and scalability of our approach for parameter-efficient continual learning in large language models.
sentences.zh: 这些结果展示了我们的方法在大语言模型中参数高效持续学习的有效性与可扩展性。

sentences.en: Our code will be open-sourced soon.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将很快开源。

title_en: COPF: An Online Framework for Deployment-Stable Counterfactual Fairness in Evolving Graphs
title_zh: COPF：演化图中实现部署稳定反事实公平的在线框架

sentences.en: Online link recommendation on evolving graphs is performative: by choosing which candidate links to show users, the system changes which links form and what feedback it later observes.
sentences.zh: 演化图上的在线链接推荐具有表演性：通过选择向用户展示哪些候选链接，系统改变了哪些链接得以形成以及它随后观察到什么反馈。

sentences.en: Consequently, fairness estimates from logged outcomes can be misleading and may drift after deployment when the recommendation policy is updated.
sentences.zh: 因此，来自记录结果的公平性估计可能具有误导性，并且在推荐策略更新后于部署阶段发生漂移。

sentences.en: We introduce COPF (Counterfactual Online Performative Fairness), a decision-layer framework for deployment-stable fairness monitoring and control in online link recommendation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 COPF（反事实在线表演性公平性），一个面向在线链接推荐中部署稳定公平性监测与控制的决策层框架。

sentences.en: COPF (i) defines group-level opportunity gaps over exposure (shown vs. not shown) counterfactuals, (ii) makes them estimable by explicit exploration and by logging the probability (propensity) that each candidate is shown, and (iii) audits and controls fairness using residual outcome indistinguishability (OI) over a configurable auditor family with graph-aware doubly robust (GA-DR) estimators.
sentences.zh: COPF（i）定义暴露（展示与未展示）反事实上的群体级机会差距，（ii）通过显式探索与记录每个候选被展示的概率（倾向性）使其可估计，并且（iii）使用带图感知双重稳健（GA-DR）估计器、在一族可配置审计器上用残差结果不可区分性（OI）审计并控制公平性。

sentences.en: We provide a noisy transfer theorem showing that Residual-OI on estimated GA-DR residuals implies bounds on exposure-counterfactual group gaps under temporal mixing and bounded local interference, and we instantiate an online multicalibration auditor together with a primal-dual controller.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了一个有噪声的传递定理，表明在时间混合与有界局部干扰下，基于估计 GA-DR 残差的 Residual-OI 意味着对暴露反事实群体差距的界，并实例化了一个在线多校准审计器以及一个原始-对偶控制器。

sentences.en: Experiments on two TGB streams and a controlled synthetic bipartite stream show that COPF reduces worst-case spikes in exposure-counterfactual group disparities with modest impact on ranking utility.
sentences.zh: 在两个 TGB 流与一个受控合成二分图上流上的实验表明，COPF 在适度影响排序效用的同时，降低了暴露反事实群体差异的最坏情况尖峰。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/lsnnnnnnnn/COPF.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/lsnnnnnnnn/COPF 获取。

title_en: Copula-SVI: Vine-Copula Variational Inference with Stein Refining for Instance-Level Correlation Capturing
title_zh: Copula-SVI：结合 Stein 细化的藤 Copula 变分推断，以捕获实例级相关性

sentences.en: Mean-field variational inference (VI) is scalable, but its independence assumption can severely limit inference when the posterior is inherently coupled across instances especially for correlated data.
sentences.zh: 均场变分推断（VI）可扩展，但其独立性假设在后验本质上是跨实例耦合（尤其是对于相关数据）时，可能严重限制推断。

sentences.en: Existing structured VI approaches either impose simple dependence patterns or incur substantial cost as dependence becomes richer, leaving efficient higher-order instance-level dependence modeling largely unresolved.
sentences.zh: 现有的结构化 VI 方法要么施加简单的依赖模式，要么随着依赖变得丰富而产生可观的成本，使高效的高阶实例级依赖建模在很大程度上仍未解决。

sentences.en: We propose Copula-SVI, which augments amortized marginals with an explicit vine-copula posterior and refines joint samples with Stein updates toward the true posterior.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Copula-SVI，它用显式的藤 copula 后验增广摊销边缘，并用 Stein 更新将联合样本朝真实后验精炼。

sentences.en: The vine construction makes dependence learning and sampling practical by decomposing it into bivariate copula factors, enabling edge-minibatched training with variance-aware level-wise sampling and efficient dependence-aware initialization via a sparse vine built from the same sampled edges.
sentences.zh: 藤结构通过将其分解为双变量 copula 因子，使依赖学习与采样变得实用，支持带有方差感知的分层采样的边小批量训练，以及通过从相同采样边构建的稀疏藤进行高效依赖感知初始化。

sentences.en: Experiments on constrained clustering and time series modeling show consistent improvements over strong structured VI baselines and demonstrate efficient higher-order instance-level dependence modeling.
sentences.zh: 在约束聚类与时间序列建模上的实验表明，相较于强结构化 VI 基线取得了一致的改进，并展示了高效的高阶实例级依赖建模。

title_en: Copyright-Bench: Agentic Evaluation of Copyright Law Compliance
title_zh: Copyright-Bench：版权法合规性的智能体式评估

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly perform commercial tasks that involve retrieving external content such as images and, where appropriate, reproducing that content.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益执行涉及检索外部内容（例如图像）并在适当时复制该内容的商业任务。

sentences.en: LLM agents should comply with the law, including the laws of copyright.
sentences.zh: LLM 智能体应当遵守法律，包括版权法。

sentences.en: Yet today we lack adequate tools to assess whether they do so.
sentences.zh: 然而今天，我们缺乏评估其是否遵守的充分工具。

sentences.en: To that end,  we introduce Copyright-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate copyright law compliance of LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入 Copyright-Bench，一个旨在评估 LLM 智能体版权法合规性的基准。

sentences.en: Copyright-Bench is comprised of realistic commercial tasks---website development, merchandise design, and corporate content production---that involve agents selecting between freely licensed content (the use of which is legal) and copyrighted content (the use of which is illegal at least in this setting).
sentences.zh: Copyright-Bench 由现实的商业任务组成——网站开发、商品设计与企业内容制作——这些任务涉及智能体在自由许可内容（其使用是合法的）与受版权保护内容（至少在此设定中其使用是非法的）之间进行选择。

sentences.en: Notably, the evaluation introduces prompt variations that simulate different levels of user intent and time pressure.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，该评估引入了模拟不同用户意图水平与时间压力的提示变体。

sentences.en: Comparing state-of-the-art agents against a human baseline, we find that: (1) LLM agents take actions that violate copyright law despite the availability of lawful alternatives; and (2) violation rates increase in response to user intent and under simulated time pressure.
sentences.zh: 将最先进的智能体与人类基线进行比较，我们发现：（1）LLM 智能体尽管存在合法替代方案仍采取违反版权法的行动；（2）违规率随用户意图以及模拟时间压力而增加。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: CORAL: Uncertainty-Aware Regulation of Exposure Concentration in Recommender Systems
title_zh: CORAL：推荐系统中曝光集中度的不确定性感知调控

sentences.en: Recommender systems (RS) may suffer from feedback-driven exposure concentration, where repeated engagement optimization collapses exposure onto a narrow set of categories, reducing catalog coverage and degrading long-horizon learning.
sentences.zh: 推荐系统（RS）可能遭受反馈驱动的曝光浓度问题，即重复的参与优化将曝光坍缩到一组狭窄类别上，降低目录覆盖度并使长时序学习退化。

sentences.en: Existing methods are often post hoc and typically lack principled uncertainty-aware risk estimates for regulating exposure under endogenous feedback.
sentences.zh: 现有方法往往是事后的，并且通常缺乏用于在内生反馈下调节曝光的有原则的不确定性感知风险估计。

sentences.en: We therefore propose **CORAL**, a model-agnostic, uncertainty-aware framework that formulates exposure regulation as a constrained sequential decision problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出 **CORAL**，一个模型无关、不确定性感知的框架，它将曝光调节表述为一个受约束的顺序决策问题。

sentences.en: Specifically, we model self-reinforcing interactions to construct an exposure-saturation state, then derive an upper confidence bound on category-conditioned violation risk from observed history and incorporate it through a state-dependent penalty for adaptive intervention near saturation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们对自我强化的交互进行建模以构建一个曝光饱和状态，然后从观测历史推导类别条件违规风险的上置信界，并通过一个与状态相关的惩罚在接近饱和时将其纳入，以实现自适应干预。

sentences.en: Moreover, we provide theoretical guarantees for risk bounds, finite-time recovery, and efficient long-term performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为风险界、有限时间恢复与高效长期性能提供理论保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on real-world datasets and controlled simulations validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, which aligns with our theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: 在真实数据集与受控仿真上的大量实验验证了所提框架的有效性，这与我们的理论分析一致。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: https://github.com/downw/CORAL.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/downw/CORAL 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: CORE-MTL: Rethinking Gradient Balancing via Causal Orthogonal Representations
title_zh: CORE-MTL：通过因果正交表征重新思考梯度平衡

sentences.en: Multi-task learning (MTL) aims to construct a joint model for multiple tasks by sharing a common representation across domains.
sentences.zh: 多任务学习（MTL）旨在通过跨域共享一个共同表示来为多个任务构建联合模型。

sentences.en: To achieve this goal, existing optimization-centric methods either balance task gradients or modify the shared architecture.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一目标，现有的以优化为中心的方法要么平衡任务梯度，要么修改共享架构。

sentences.en: However, as these approaches remain agnostic to the content of the shared representation, they fail to disentangle task-relevant structure from spurious context, leading to negative transfer and poor generalization.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于这些方法对共享表示的内容视而不见，它们无法将任务相关结构与虚假上下文解耦，导致负迁移与较差的泛化。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose Causal Orthogonal Representations for Multi-Task Learning (CORE-MTL) , a representation-centric framework that structurally disentangles the shared representation into semantic and residual streams, concentrating task-relevant structure in the semantic stream while relegating nuisance variation to the residual stream.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出多任务学习因果正交表示（CORE-MTL），一个以表示为中心的框架，它将共享表示结构性解耦为语义流与残差流，将任务相关结构集中于语义流，同时将干扰变化归入残差流。

sentences.en: We instantiate this framework in the visual domain by leveraging physical priors for structured scenes and statistical constraints for attributes.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在视觉域中利用结构化场景的物理先验与属性的统计约束来实例化这一框架。

sentences.en: Theoretically, our method enjoys a tighter out-of-distribution generalization bound than optimization-centric methods and reduces task gradient interference without explicit gradient projection or reweighting.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们的方法拥有比以优化为中心的方法更紧的分布外泛化界，并在无需显式梯度投影或重加权的情况下减少任务梯度干扰。

sentences.en: Empirically, CORE-MTL consistently outperforms existing methods on visual multi-task benchmarks in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，CORE-MTL 在分布内与分布外设定中的视觉多任务基准上一致地优于现有方法。

title_en: CoRe: Collaborative Reasoning via Cross Teaching
title_zh: CoRe：通过交叉教学实现协作推理

sentences.en: Large language models exhibit complementary reasoning errors: on the same instance, one model may succeed with a particular decomposition while another fails.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型表现出互补的推理错误：在同一实例上，一个模型可能以某种特定的分解取得成功，而另一个模型则失败。

sentences.en: We propose Collaborative Reasoning (CoRe), a training-time collaboration framework that converts peer success into a learning signal via a cross-teaching protocol.
sentences.zh: 我们提出协作推理（CoRe），一个训练时协作框架，它通过交叉教学协议将同伴的成功转化为学习信号。

sentences.en: Each problem is solved in two stages: a cold round of independent sampling, followed by a contexted rescue round in which failed models receive a hint extracted from a successful peer.
sentences.zh: 每个问题分两个阶段求解：一轮独立的样本抽取，随后是一轮情境化的营救，其中失败的模型会收到从成功同伴提取的提示。

sentences.en: CoRe optimizes a combined reward that balances (i) correctness, (ii) a lightweight DPP-inspired diversity term to reduce error overlap, and (iii) an explicit rescue bonus for successful recovery.
sentences.zh: CoRe 优化一个组合奖励，它在以下三者之间取得平衡：（i）正确性，（ii）一个轻量级、受 DPP 启发的多样性项以减少错误重叠，以及（iii）一个针对成功恢复的显式营救奖励。

sentences.en: We evaluate CoRe in low-data regimes across GSM8K, MATH, AIME, and GPQA.
sentences.zh: 我们在 GSM8K、MATH、AIME 与 GPQA 的低数据情境下评估了 CoRe。

sentences.en: With only 1,000 training examples, a pair of small open-source models (3B+4B) reaches 99.54% oracle Team Pass@2 on GSM8K and 92.08% on MATH, compared to 82.50% and 74.82% for single-model training.
sentences.zh: 仅用 1,000 个训练示例，一对小开源模型（3B+4B）就在 GSM8K 上达到 99.54% 的 oracle 团队 Pass@2，在 MATH 上达到 92.08%，而单模型训练分别为 82.50% 与 74.82%。

sentences.en: On harder datasets, the same pair reaches 77.34% oracle Team Pass@2 on GPQA (trained on 348 examples) and 79.65% on AIME (trained on 792 examples), using a training-time budget of at most 1536 context tokens and 3072 generated tokens.
sentences.zh: 在更困难的数据集上，同一对模型在 GPQA 上达到 77.34% 的 oracle 团队 Pass@2（在 348 个示例上训练），在 AIME 上达到 79.65%（在 792 个示例上训练），使用至多 1536 个上下文词元与 3072 个生成词元的训练时预算。

sentences.en: A three-model non-oracle AIME evaluation further closes most of the oracle-selection gap (81.20% majority vote vs. 82.60% oracle Team Pass@2).
sentences.zh: 一个三模型的非 oracle AIME 评估进一步弥合了大部分 oracle 选择差距（81.20% 多数投票对比 82.60% 的 oracle 团队 Pass@2）。

sentences.en: Overall, these results show that training-time collaboration can reliably convert model complementarity into large gains without scaling model size.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这些结果表明，训练时协作能够在不扩大模型规模的情况下，可靠地将模型互补性转化为大幅收益。

title_en: CoRe: Combined Rewards with Vision-Language Model Feedback for Preference-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: CoRe：结合视觉语言模型反馈的复合奖励，用于偏好对齐强化学习

sentences.en: Reward design remains a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL).
sentences.zh: 奖励设计仍然是强化学习（RL）中的核心挑战。

sentences.en: Hand-crafted rewards are often difficult to specify and may lead to suboptimal policies, while learned rewards from preferences can suffer from inefficiency and unstable training.
sentences.zh: 手工设计奖励往往难以指定，并可能导致次优策略，而基于偏好的学习奖励可能遭受低效与训练不稳的困扰。

sentences.en: Inspired by the dual nature of human learning explored in cognitive science, we decompose rewards into two complementary components: Formal Rewards (FR), explicitly designed based on task knowledge, and Residual Rewards (RR), learned from observations to capture implicit and nuanced preferences.
sentences.zh: 受认知科学中探索到的人类学习双重本质的启发，我们将奖励分解为两个互补的组成部分：形式奖励（FR），基于任务知识显式设计；以及残差奖励（RR），从观测中学习以捕获隐式与微妙的偏好。

sentences.en: Based on this decomposition, we propose CoRe, a hybrid framework that integrates FR and RR with vision-language models (VLMs) feedback to achieve preference-aligned policies without human involvement.
sentences.zh: 基于这一分解，我们提出 CoRe，一个将 FR 与 RR 及视觉-语言模型（VLM）反馈整合起来的混合框架，以便在无需人工参与的情况下实现偏好对齐的策略。

sentences.en: Our contributions are twofold: (1) We propose a Formal Reward Module (FRM) that leverages VLMs to iteratively design and optimize FR based on task knowledge and preference feedback, enabling the continual improvement of policy during training;
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献有两方面：（1）我们提出形式奖励模块（FRM），它利用 VLM 基于任务知识与偏好反馈迭代地设计与优化 FR，从而在训练期间持续改进策略；

sentences.en: (2) We introduce a Residual Reward Module (RRM) that learns RR from video-level preference by employing VLMs to generate preference labels and capturing nuanced rewards that complement FR, ensuring alignment with human intent.
sentences.zh: （2）我们引入残差奖励模块（RRM），它通过使用 VLM 生成偏好标签来从视频级偏好学习 RR，并捕获补充 FR 的微妙奖励，确保与人类意图对齐。

sentences.en: Through the synergy of FRM and RRM, CoRe enables the automatic construction of reliable rewards that are efficient and preference-aligned.
sentences.zh: 通过 FRM 与 RRM 的协同作用，CoRe 实现了可靠奖励的自动构建，既高效又偏好对齐。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoRe outperforms existing approaches in terms of policy learning effectiveness and efficiency on ten robotic manipulation tasks in simulation and five real-worlds.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在模拟环境中的十个机器人操作任务与五个真实世界任务上，CoRe 在策略学习有效性与效率方面都优于现有方法。

title_en: CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning for General Multimodal Manipulation Detection
title_zh: CORE：面向通用多模态篡改检测的冲突导向推理

sentences.en: The rapid rise of generative AI has made multimodal fake news increasingly realistic and pervasive, posing severe threats to public trust and social stability.
sentences.zh: 生成式 AI 的迅速崛起使多模态假新闻日益逼真且泛滥，对公众信任与社会稳定构成严重威胁。

sentences.en: Existing detection methods rely heavily on manipulation-specific models and large-scale labeled data, resulting in poor generalization to emerging manipulation types.
sentences.zh: 现有检测方法严重依赖特定于伪造手段的模型与大规模标注数据，导致对新兴伪造手段的泛化能力较差。

sentences.en: We observed that the essence of manipulated misinformation lies in its intrinsic conflicts, i.e., semantic or physical inconsistencies either across modalities or with common world knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，伪造错误信息的本质在于其内在的冲突，即跨模态或与常识相悖的语义或物理不一致。

sentences.en: Inspired by this observation, we propose  Conflict-{Oriented REasoning (CORE) framework, an effective paradigm that learns to endows multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with explicit conflict-capturing capability.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察的启发，我们提出冲突导向推理（CORE）框架，一种有效的范式，它学习赋予多模态大语言模型（MLLM）显式的冲突捕获能力。

sentences.en: To this end, CORE first constructs the Conflict Attribution Corpus (CAC) with fine-grained annotations of conflict factors and sources, providing essential data support for subsequent conflict perception training.
sentences.zh: 为此，CORE 首先构建冲突归因语料（CAC），其中包含冲突因子与来源的细粒度标注，为后续的冲突感知训练提供必要的数据支撑。

sentences.en: By performing conflict-oriented representation enhancement and reasoning based on CAC, CORE achieves robust and generalizable conflict detection, effectively and rapidly adapting to unseen manipulation types with a few samples or in even zero-shot settings.
sentences.zh: 通过基于 CAC 执行冲突导向的表示增强与推理，CORE 实现了稳健且可泛化的冲突检测，能够仅凭少量样本甚至在零样本设定下有效且快速地适应未见过的伪造手段。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CORE surpasses state-of-the-art models by 9.7\%, 14.1\%, and 11.8\% in accuracy on the DGM$^4$, MMFakeBench, and MDSM benchmarks, respectively.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在 DGM$^4$、MMFakeBench 与 MDSM 基准上，CORE 在精度上分别超越最先进模型 9.7\%、14.1\% 与 11.8\%。

title_en: CORE: Context-Robust Remasking for Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: CORE：扩散语言模型的上下文鲁棒重新掩码

sentences.en: Standard decoding in Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) is hindered by context rigidity: tokens are retained based on transient high confidence, often ignoring that early predictions lack full context.
sentences.zh: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）中的标准解码受上下文僵化的阻碍：词元基于瞬时的较高置信度而被保留，常常忽略了早期预测缺乏完整上下文这一事实。

sentences.en: This creates cascade effects where initial inconsistencies misguide the remaining generation.
sentences.zh: 这造成了级联效应，使最初的不一致误导了剩余的生成。

sentences.en: Existing revision strategies attempt to mitigate this by relying on static confidence scores, but these signals are inherently myopic; inconsistent tokens frequently appear confident to the model itself.
sentences.zh: 现有的修订策略试图通过依赖静态置信度分数来缓解这一问题，但这些信号本质上是短视的；不一致的词元在模型自身看来常常显得自信。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Context-Robust Remasking (CORE), a training-free framework for inference-time revision.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出上下文稳健重新掩码（CORE），一个用于推理时修订的免训练框架。

sentences.en: We introduce a new selection paradigm: rather than trusting static token probabilities, we identify *context-brittle* tokens by probing their sensitivity to adversarial perturbations.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种新的选择范式：与其信任静态词元概率，我们通过探测词元对对抗性扰动的敏感性来识别*上下文脆弱*词元。

sentences.en: We formalize revision as a robust optimization problem targeting worst-case context shifts.
sentences.zh: 我们将修订形式化为一个针对最坏情况上下文偏移的稳健优化问题。

sentences.en: CORE efficiently approximates this objective using theoretically bounded probability margins to expose and revise unstable tokens.
sentences.zh: CORE 利用理论上界定的概率边际高效地近似这一目标，以暴露并修订不稳定的词元。

sentences.en: On LLaDA-8B-Base, CORE delivers consistent improvements across reasoning and code benchmarks, outperforming compute-matched baselines and boosting performance on code generation (MBPP) by up to $+9.2\\%$, with comparable gains generalizing to the Dream-7B architecture.
sentences.zh: 在 LLaDA-8B-Base 上，CORE 在推理与代码基准上带来一致的改进，优于计算匹配的基线，并将代码生成（MBPP）性能提升高达 +9.2\%，类似的收益也泛化到 Dream-7B 架构。

title_en: Correct Looks Better: Pairwise Comparisons Reveal Accuracy Rankings
title_zh: 正确的看起来更好：成对比较揭示准确率排名

sentences.en: Pairwise comparisons combined with aggregation methods like Elo have become central to evaluating generative models, yet concerns remain that they reward superficial stylistic cues or display judge biases.
sentences.zh: 成对比较与 Elo 等聚合方法相结合，已成为评估生成模型的核心手段，但仍有人担心它们会奖励肤浅的风格线索或表现出评判者偏见。

sentences.en: In a more positive turn, we show that model rankings from pairwise comparisons strongly agree with ground-truth-based accuracy rankings when such ground truth is available for comparison.
sentences.zh: 从更积极的角度看，我们表明，当能够获得比较所用的真实标签时，由成对比较得出的模型排名与基于真实标签的精度排名高度一致。

sentences.en: By converting five well-known benchmarks into free-form generative evaluations, we find that Elo rankings achieve a Spearman correlation above 0.9 with accuracy rankings and substantially outperform direct evaluation when the judge is weak.
sentences.zh: 通过将五个知名基准转化为自由形式生成评估，我们发现 Elo 排名与精度排名的 Spearman 相关性超过 0.9，并且在评判者较弱时大幅优于直接评估。

sentences.en: Furthermore, style and judge bias have only minor effects on model rankings, despite most judgments occurring on pairs where both candidate answers are correct (or incorrect).
sentences.zh: 此外，尽管大多数判断发生在两个候选答案都正确（或都不正确）的配对对上，风格与评判者偏见对模型排名的影响很小。

sentences.en: On such pairs, we find that repetition after the final answer (*echo*) is a causal driver of judge preference.
sentences.zh: 在诸如此类的配对对上，我们发现在最终答案之后的重复（*echo*）是评判者偏好的因果驱动因素。

title_en: CORRECT: COndensed eRror RECognition via knowledge Transfer in multi-agent systems
title_zh: CORRECT：通过多智能体系统中的知识迁移进行凝练错误识别

sentences.en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly capable of tackling complex real-world tasks, yet their reliance on inter-agent coordination, tool use, and long-horizon reasoning makes error recognition particularly challenging.
sentences.zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）日益能够处理复杂的现实任务，然而它们对智能体间协调、工具使用与长时序推理的依赖使误差识别尤其具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Minor errors can propagate across agents, escalating into task failures while producing long, intertwined execution trajectories that impose significant costs for both human developers and automated systems to debug and analyze.
sentences.zh: 细微错误可以跨智能体传播，升级为任务失败，同时产生冗长且交错的执行轨迹，为人类开发者与自动化系统带来显著的调试与分析成本。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that, despite surface differences in failure trajectories (e.g., logs), MAS errors often recur with similar structural patterns.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，尽管失败轨迹（例如日志）存在表面差异，MAS 误差往往以相似的结构模式复发。

sentences.en: This paper presents CORRECT, the first lightweight, training-free framework that leverages an online cache of distilled error schemata to recognize and transfer knowledge of failure structures across new requests.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 CORRECT，第一个轻量级、免训练的框架，它利用在线缓存的浓缩误差模式，在新请求间识别并迁移失败结构的知识。

sentences.en: This cache-based reuse allows LLMs to perform targeted error localization at inference time, avoiding the need for expensive retraining while adapting to dynamic MAS deployments in subseconds.
sentences.zh: 这种基于缓存的重用使 LLM 能够在推理时进行有针对性的误差定位，避免昂贵的重训练，同时在亚秒级内适应动态的 MAS 部署。

sentences.en: To support rigorous study in this domain, we also introduce CORRECT-Error, a large-scale dataset of over 2,000 annotated trajectories collected through a novel error-injection pipeline guided by real-world distributions, and further validated through human evaluation to ensure alignment with natural failure patterns.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一领域的严谨研究，我们还引入 CORRECT-Error，一个包含超过 2,000 条标注轨迹的大规模数据集，它是通过一种由真实世界分布引导的新颖误差注入流水线收集的，并进一步通过人工评估加以验证以确保与自然失败模式一致。

sentences.en: Experiments across seven diverse MAS applications show that CORRECT improves step-level error localization up to 19.8% over existing advances while at near-zero overhead, substantially narrowing the gap between automated and human-level error recognition.
sentences.zh: 跨七个多样 MAS 应用的实验表明，CORRECT 在近乎零开销的情况下，将逐步误差定位相较于现有进展提升了多达 19.8%，大幅缩小了自动化与人类水平误差识别之间的差距。

title_en: Corrected Samplers for Discrete Flow Models
title_zh: 离散流模型的校正采样器

sentences.en: Discrete flow models (DFMs) have been proposed to learn the data distribution on finite state space, offering a flexible framework as an alternative to discrete diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 离散流模型（DFM）被提出来学习有限状态空间上的数据分布，提供了作为离散扩散模型替代方案的灵活框架。

sentences.en: A line of recent work has studied samplers for discrete diffusion models, such as tau-leaping and Euler solver.
sentences.zh: 一系列近期工作研究了离散扩散模型的采样器，例如 tau-leaping 与 Euler 求解器。

sentences.en: However, these samplers require a large number of iterations to control discretization error, since the transition rates are frozen in time and evaluated at the initial state within each time interval.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些采样器需要大量迭代来控制离散化误差，因为转移率在时间上被冻结，并在每个时间区间内于初始状态处求值。

sentences.en: Moreover, theoretical results for these samplers often require boundedness conditions of the transition rate or they focus on a specific type of source distributions.
sentences.zh: 此外，这些采样器的理论结果常常要求转移率的有界性条件，或聚焦于特定类型的源分布。

sentences.en: To address those limitations, we establish non-asymptotic discretization error bounds for those samplers without any restriction on transition rates and source distributions, under the framework of discrete flow models.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们在离散流模型的框架下，为这些采样器建立了对转移率与源分布无任何限制的非渐近离散化误差界。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by analyzing a one-step lower bound of the Euler sampler, we propose two corrected samplers: \textit{time-corrected sampler} and \textit{location-corrected sampler}, which can reduce the discretization error of tau-leaping and Euler solver with almost no additional computational cost.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过分析 Euler 采样器的单步下界，我们提出两种修正采样器：\textit{time-corrected sampler}与\textit{location-corrected sampler}，它们能够在几乎不增加计算成本的情况下降低 tau-leaping 与 Euler 求解器的离散化误差。

sentences.en: We rigorously show that the location-corrected sampler has a lower complexity than existing parallel samplers.
sentences.zh: 我们严格地表明，位置修正采样器比现有的并行采样器具有更低的复杂度。

sentences.en: We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method by achieving better generation quality with reduced inference time on simulations and text-to-image generation tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在仿真与文生图任务上以更短的推理时间获得更好的生成质量，验证了所提方法的有效性。

sentences.en: Code can be found in \url{https://github.com/WanZhengyan/Corrected-Samplers-for-Discrete-Flow-Models}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/WanZhengyan/Corrected-Samplers-for-Discrete-Flow-Models} 获取。
